cards.new_note: Isaiah 42:1 — *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* Isaiah's *mine elect* is Enoch's *Mine Elect One* (45:3) — the chosen servant in whom the Father delights, set on the throne of glory.

cards.old_note: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* The Father dwelling un-separated with His people in 1 Enoch 39:6 is the same tabernacling John hears announced over the renewed earth.
cards.new_note: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* John hears the tabernacle of Elohim (God) with men; Enoch saw the Elect One of righteousness with the righteous and the elect without number before him for ever and ever (39:6).

cards.new_note: Hebrews 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* Enoch is told no angel hinders and no power can — he himself appoints the judge and judges all (41:9). The intercession that reaches that throne is the Son's, who ever lives to make it for those who come to the Father by him.

cards.new_note: Sirach 24:8 — *So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* Wisdom, denied a dwelling among men, is given her resting-place in Jacob — the elect over whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits abides and with whom the Son of Adam eats for ever (62:14).
cards.live_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will abide over them, And with that Son of Adam shall they eat And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.

cards.old_note: Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* Yahusha names Himself the Son of Adam seated on the throne of glory to judge — the very seat from which the Elect One weighs deeds in the balance (63:5).
cards.new_note: Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* Yahusha (Jesus) names himself the Son of Adam seated on the throne of glory to judge — the seat Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits set him on, where the word of his mouth slays all the sinners (62:2).
cards.live_text: And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits seated him on the throne of His glory, And the spirit of righteousness was poured out upon him, And the word of his mouth slays all the sinners, And all the unrighteous are destroyed from before his face.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:6 — *Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.* Those who led the world astray (63:6) confess at last that they themselves erred from the way of truth.
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:6 — *Therefore have we erred from the way of truth, and the light of righteousness has not shined to us, and the sun of righteousness rose not upon us.* Those who led the world astray (69:27) confess at last that they themselves erred from the way of truth.
cards.live_text: And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.

cards.old_note: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The Son of Adam driving the sinners from the earth (63:6) exercises the everlasting dominion given Him before the Ancient of days.
cards.new_note: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The Son of Adam driving the sinners from the earth (69:27) exercises the everlasting dominion given Him before the Ancient of days.
cards.live_text: And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* The hollow boast of pride and riches is exactly the lament of Enoch's kings and earth-possessors seized with travail (63:7).
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* The hollow boast of pride and riches is exactly the confession of Enoch's kings: *our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom, and in our glory* (63:7).
cards.live_text: For we have not believed before Him Nor glorified the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, [nor glorified our Lord] But our hope was in the sceptre of our kingdom, And in our glory.

cards.old_note: Revelation 6:17 — *For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?* The day of wrath that none can stand against is Enoch's day when the kings are seized with great terror and travail-pain (63:7).
cards.new_note: Revelation 6:17 — *For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?* The day of wrath that none can stand against is Enoch's day when pain comes upon the kings and the mighty as on a woman in travail (62:4).
cards.live_text: Then shall pain come upon them as on a woman in travail, [And she has pain in bringing forth] When her child enters the mouth of the womb, And she has pain in bringing forth.

cards.old_note: Psalms 2:12 — *Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.* The perishing for ever and ever (63:9) is precisely the perishing-from-the-way the kings courted by refusing to kiss the Son while there was time.
cards.new_note: Psalms 2:12 — *Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.* Passing away from before his face on account of their works (63:9) is the perishing-from-the-way the kings courted by refusing to kiss the Son while there was time.
cards.live_text: And we pass away from before His face on account of our works, And all our sins are reckoned up in righteousness.’

cards.old_note: 2 Peter 2:3 — *And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.* Enoch's unceasing warning of the coming judgement (Enoch 65:6) is the same sentence Peter says lingers not and does not slumber.
cards.new_note: 2 Peter 2:3 — *And through covetousness shall they with feigned words make merchandise of you: whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.* The command that has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) — their ruin accomplished because of the secrets they learned (65:6) — is the sentence Peter says lingers not and does not slumber.
cards.live_text: And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:

cards.old_note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The descended angels of Enoch 65:9 are the angels Jude says left their habitation and are reserved in chains for judgement.
cards.new_note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The descended angels of Enoch 64:2 are the angels Jude says left their habitation and are reserved in chains for judgement.
cards.live_text: I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’

cards.old_note: Genesis 6:12 — *And Elohim (God) looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.* The angels who 'corrupted the earth' in Enoch 65:9 are why Moses says all flesh had corrupted its way.
cards.new_note: Genesis 6:12 — *And Elohim (God) looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.* The angels who 'corrupted the earth' in Enoch 64:2 are why Moses says all flesh had corrupted its way.
cards.live_text: I heard the voice of the angel saying: ‘These are the angels who descended to the earth, and revealed what was hidden to the children of men and seduced the children of men into committing sin.’

cards.old_note: Jubilees 5:1 — *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* The spirits of the giants in Enoch 65:10 are the offspring of the angels Jubilees says took wives and bore giants.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 5:1 — *And it came to pass when the children of men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them, that the angels of Elohim (God) saw them on a certain year of this jubilee, that they were beautiful to look upon; and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* The spirits of the giants in Enoch 15:12 are the offspring of the angels Jubilees says took wives and bore giants.
cards.live_text: And these spirits shall rise up against the children of men and against the women, because they have proceeded from them.

cards.old_note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* The Most High's punishment upon the fallen angels in Enoch 65:11 is Peter's angels that sinned, cast down and reserved unto judgement.
cards.new_note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Those who showed what was hidden have no place of repentance for ever — *they are the damned* (65:11). Peter's angels that sinned, cast down and reserved unto judgment, are these.
cards.live_text: And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.

cards.old_note: Genesis 8:21 — *And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.* The cleansed earth of Enoch 65:12 is the ground Yahuah vows not again to curse once the Flood has passed.
cards.new_note: Genesis 8:21 — *And Yahuah (LORD) smelled a sweet savour; and Yahuah (LORD) said in his heart, I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake; for the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth; neither will I again smite any more every thing living, as I have done.* The cleansed earth of Enoch 10:20 is the ground Yahuah vows not again to curse once the Flood has passed.
cards.live_text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 5:11 — *And He destroyed all from their places, and there was not left one of them whom He judged not according to all their wickedness. And He made for all His works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway.* The earth cleansed and made righteous in Enoch 65:12 is Jubilees' new and righteous nature after the Flood.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 5:11 — *And He destroyed all from their places, and there was not left one of them whom He judged not according to all their wickedness. And He made for all His works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway.* The earth cleansed and made righteous in Enoch 10:20 is Jubilees' new and righteous nature after the Flood.
cards.live_text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

cards.old_note: Revelation 21:1 — *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.* John sees the cleansed creation Enoch foresaw — the corrupted first earth passed away once all sin and iniquity are purged at 67:7.
cards.new_note: Revelation 21:1 — *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.* John sees the cleansed creation Enoch foresaw — the corrupted first earth passed away once all sin and iniquity are purged at 10:20.
cards.live_text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

cards.old_note: 2 Peter 3:13 — *Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.* Peter's hope of an earth "wherein dwelleth righteousness" is Enoch's earth cleansed from all unrighteousness, sin, and iniquity at 67:7.
cards.new_note: 2 Peter 3:13 — *Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness.* Peter's hope of an earth *wherein dwelleth righteousness* is Enoch's earth cleansed from all oppression, all unrighteousness, all sin and all godlessness (10:20).
cards.live_text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

cards.old_note: Isaiah 65:17 — *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.* Isaiah's new creation is Enoch's earth cleansed from all corruption — the defiled former order wiped away and remembered no more.
cards.new_note: Isaiah 65:17 — *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.* Isaiah's new creation is Enoch's earth cleansed from all unrighteousness and uncleanness (10:20) — the defiled former order wiped away and remembered no more.
cards.live_text: And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.

cards.old_note: 2 Peter 2:4 — *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment.* Peter carries the same Watcher-tradition Enoch records: the sinning angels cast down and kept in chains of darkness until the sentence Enoch 67:1 sees finally consummated.

Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The reserving of the fallen angels for "the judgment of the great day" is exactly Enoch's "that great day" when their punishment is consummated in the abyss of fire.
cards.new_note: Jude 1:6 — *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* The reserving of the fallen angels for the judgment of the great day is Enoch's *in those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire* (10:13) — the prison kept for them till then.
cards.live_text: In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.

cards.old_note: Psalms 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The same ordering hand that weighs the winds in 71:8 appoints the lights of the moon — the Creator's measured order, looking ahead to Enoch's Luminaries.
cards.new_note: Psalms 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The same ordering hand that weighs the winds in 60:12 appoints the lights of the moon — the Creator's measured order, looking ahead to Enoch's Luminaries.
cards.live_text: And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the portals of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.

cards.old_note: Job 38:22 — *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail.* The storehouses of the heavens Enoch is shown in 71:8 are the same treasure-chambers Yahuah challenges Job to enter — the Creator's hidden ordering of the elements.
cards.new_note: Job 38:22 — *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail.* The storehouses of the heavens Enoch is shown in 60:12 are the same treasure-chambers Yahuah challenges Job to enter — the Creator's hidden ordering of the elements.

cards.old_note: Psalm 89:37 — *It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.* The moon Enoch watches wax from a horn to full is the heaven's faithful witness — her steady cycle pledges the steadiness of the covenant.
cards.new_note: Psalm 89:37 — *It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.* The moon Enoch watches wax to fifteen parts and wane part by part (78:7–8) is the heaven's faithful witness — her steady count pledges the steadiness of the covenant.
cards.live_text: And in her waning (the moon) decreases on the first day to fourteen parts of her light, on the second to thirteen parts of light, on the third to twelve, on the fourth to eleven, on the fifth to ten, on the sixth to nine, on the seventh to eight, on the eighth to seven, on the ninth to six, on the tenth to five, on the eleventh to four, on the twelfth to three, on the thirteenth to two, on the fourteenth to the half of a seventh, and all her remaining light disappears wholly on the fifteenth.

cards.old_note: Ecclesiasticus 43:6 — *He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.* The waxing and waning Enoch numbers is the moon serving "in her season" as the declared sign of the times.
cards.new_note: Ecclesiasticus 43:6 — *He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.* The waning Enoch numbers part by part (78:8) is the moon serving in her season as the declared sign of the times.
cards.live_text: And in her waning (the moon) decreases on the first day to fourteen parts of her light, on the second to thirteen parts of light, on the third to twelve, on the fourth to eleven, on the fifth to ten, on the sixth to nine, on the seventh to eight, on the eighth to seven, on the ninth to six, on the tenth to five, on the eleventh to four, on the twelfth to three, on the thirteenth to two, on the fourteenth to the half of a seventh, and all her remaining light disappears wholly on the fifteenth.

cards.old_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* As the moon's light "waxes and wanes according to the number of days," she keeps the seasons she was appointed to mark.
cards.new_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* As fifteen parts of light are transferred to the moon till her light is accomplished according to the sign of the year (78:7), she keeps the seasons she was appointed to mark.
cards.live_text: And fifteen parts of light are transferred to her till the fifteenth day (when) her light is accomplished, according to the sign of the year, and she becomes fifteen parts, and the moon grows by (the addition of) fourteenth parts.

cards.old_note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The orderly circuit of the moon through the six portals is the firmament preaching the Maker's handiwork, the same witness Uriel unfolds to Enoch.
cards.new_note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The positions and months of the luminaries Uriel showed Enoch and he wrote down (74:2) are the firmament preaching the Maker's handiwork.
cards.live_text: And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.

cards.old_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The luminaries Uriel shows Enoch are the very lights set for the appointed times (moedim) on the fourth day.
cards.new_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The luminaries Uriel shows Enoch are the very lights set for the appointed times (moedim) on the fourth day.
cards.live_text: And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.

cards.old_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The moon's return through her portals to complete her light is the Creator's own appointment of the seasons, not a man-made scheme.
cards.new_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The moon accomplishing all her light in the east and all her darkness in the west, by sevenths (74:3), is the Creator's own appointment of the seasons, not a man-made scheme.
cards.live_text: In single seventh parts she accomplishes all her light in the east, and in single seventh parts accomplishes all her darkness in the west.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* Jubilees names the same shortfall Enoch records — the lunar 354 against the solar 364, ten days short each year.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* Jubilees names the same shortfall Enoch records — the moon falling behind the sun and the stars, six days every year, thirty in five (74:11). Enoch counts her against the sun; Jubilees counts her ten days short of the 364; both say the moon cannot keep the year.
cards.live_text: And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.

cards.old_note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* The luminaries that mark the reckoning are servants of the appointed times, never to be worshipped — the host of heaven is the Creator's order, not a god to serve.
cards.new_note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* The luminaries that mark the reckoning are servants of the appointed times, never to be worshipped — the host of heaven is the Creator's order, not a god to serve.
cards.live_text: And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.

cards.old_note: 1 Chronicles 27:1 — *Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.* The captains of thousands serving by months in Enoch 75:4 are mirrored on earth by Israel's monthly courses of captains of thousands — the heavenly ranks ordering time as the priestly ranks order service.
cards.new_note: 1 Chronicles 27:1 — *Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.* The leaders of the heads of thousands set over the whole creation and the stars, who serve on the four days outside the count of the year (75:1), are mirrored on earth by Israel's courses of captains of thousands — the heavenly ranks ordering time as the priestly ranks order service.

cards.old_note: Psalms 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The leaders set over the seasons in Enoch 75:6 keep the very appointment the Psalmist celebrates — the moon for the moedim, the sun for its setting.

cards.old_note: Job 37:9 — *Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.* Job sorts the winds by quarter just as Enoch's southern and northern portals send heat-and-drought against cold-and-drought.
cards.new_note: Job 37:9 — *Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.* Job sorts the winds by quarter just as Enoch's portals do — the east wind of the first portal bringing desolation, drought, heat, and destruction (76:5), the north portals cold and frost.
cards.live_text: And the first wind from those portals, called the east wind, comes forth through the first portal which is in the east, inclining towards the south: from it come forth desolation, drought, heat, and destruction.

cards.old_note: Genesis 3:7 — *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* Enoch's words "his eyes are opened" repeat Eden's account of the fruit that opened the eyes of Adam and his wife.

Genesis 2:9 — *And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.* Enoch's "tree of wisdom" in the paradise of righteousness is the Torah's tree set in the midst of the garden.

cards.old_note: Psalm 148:5 — *Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for he commanded, and they were created.* Enoch frames the names "according to the law and the reckoning of their light"; Psalm 148 grounds that law in the Creator's command that made them.
cards.new_note: Psalm 148:5 — *Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for he commanded, and they were created.* Enoch names the sun by name — Orjârês and Tômâs (78:1); Psalm 148 grounds the naming in the Creator's command that made them.
cards.live_text: And the names of the sun are the following: the first Orjârês, and the second Tômâs.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.* The 364-day revolution of Enoch 78:4 is the very reckoning Jubilees commands Israel keep so the feasts are not disturbed.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.* The sun and the stars completing the years with perfect justice in 364 days (74:12) is the very reckoning Jubilees commands Israel keep so the feasts are not disturbed.
cards.live_text: And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.

cards.old_note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The luminaries that complete their courses in righteousness (Enoch 78:9) are the firmament preaching its Maker's order without a word.
cards.new_note: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The luminaries that complete their courses in righteousness (Enoch 69:20) are the firmament preaching its Maker's order without a word.
cards.live_text: And through that oath the sun and moon complete their course, And deviate not from their ordinance from eternity to eternity.

cards.live_text: And through that oath the sun and moon complete their course, And deviate not from their ordinance from eternity to eternity.

cards.old_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The moon and sun Enoch sets for seasons and days are the same lights the Psalm appoints for the seasons — the Creator's order of the moedim.
cards.new_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The first day is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her (78:12) — the moon appointed for the seasons, the Creator's order of the appointed times.
cards.live_text: And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.

cards.old_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years.* Enoch 78:12 quotes the fourth-day mandate almost word for word — the lights set for signs, seasons (the moedim), days, and years.
cards.new_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years.* The new moon named on its first day (78:12) is one of the signs and seasons the fourth-day mandate set the lights for.
cards.live_text: And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* The very ten-day gap Enoch records — the moon falling behind by ten days — is the disturbance Jubilees warns of when men reckon by the moon alone.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* Enoch records the moon falling behind the sun and the order of the stars (79:5) — the disturbance Jubilees warns of when men reckon by the moon alone.
cards.live_text: She falls behind the sun and the order of the stars exactly five days in the course of one period, and when this place which thou seest has been traversed.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.* The 364-day year Enoch completes is the same reckoning Jubilees commands Israel to keep so the feasts are not disturbed.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.* The 364 days Enoch counts when the years are full (74:10) is the same reckoning Jubilees commands Israel to keep so the feasts are not disturbed.
cards.live_text: And if five years are added together the sun has an overplus of thirty days, and all the days which accrue to it for one of those five years, when they are full, amount to 364 days.

cards.old_note: Romans 1:25 — *Who changed the truth of Elohim (God) into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.* Paul names the root of Enoch 80:1's star-worship: the created luminary served in place of the Creator who appointed it.
cards.new_note: Romans 1:25 — *Who changed the truth of Elohim (God) into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.* Paul names the root of the error Enoch foretells — the order of the stars concealed from the sinners, who err and take them to be gods (80:7): the created luminary served in place of the Creator who appointed it.
cards.live_text: And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.

cards.old_note: Jeremiah 8:2 — *And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped: they shall not be gathered, nor be buried; they shall be for dung upon the face of the earth.* Jeremiah's idolaters loved and served the same sun, moon, and host that Enoch 80:1 says men come to mistake for gods.

cards.old_note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* When Enoch's lights fall out of order, men err and worship the host of heaven — the very driving-away Moses forbade.
cards.new_note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* When the chiefs of the stars transgress their order and alter their orbits (80:6), men err and worship the host of heaven — the very driving-away Moses forbade.
cards.live_text: And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.

cards.old_note: Deuteronomy 6:7 — *And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.* Enoch's charge to tell his children and the children of his children (81:3) is the Shema's command to teach the next generation diligently.
cards.new_note: Deuteronomy 6:7 — *And thou shalt teach them diligently unto thy children, and shalt talk of them when thou sittest in thine house, and when thou walkest by the way, and when thou liest down, and when thou risest up.* Enoch's charge to teach his children and record it for them and testify to all his children (81:6) is the Shema's command to teach the next generation diligently.
cards.live_text: One year we will leave thee with thy son, till thou givest thy (last) commands, that thou mayst teach thy children and record (it) for them, and testify to all thy children; and in the second year they shall take thee from their midst.

cards.old_note: Proverbs 3:3 — *Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:* Enoch writes the wisdom down lest it be lost (81:5); the canon writes the same on the tablet of the heart.
cards.new_note: Proverbs 3:3 — *Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:* Enoch writes the wisdom down lest it be lost (82:1); the canon writes the same on the tablet of the heart.
cards.live_text: And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father’s hand, and (see) that thou deliver them to the generations of the world.

cards.old_note: Deuteronomy 6:6 — *And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:* The words of truth Enoch writes for Methuselah to preserve (81:5) are the commanded words kept in the heart so they are not lost.
cards.new_note: Deuteronomy 6:6 — *And these words, which I command thee this day, shall be in thine heart:* The words of truth Enoch writes for Methuselah to preserve (82:1) are the commanded words kept in the heart so they are not lost.
cards.live_text: And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father’s hand, and (see) that thou deliver them to the generations of the world.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:37 — *For this reason the years will come upon them when they will disturb (the order), and make an abominable (day) the day of testimony, and an unclean day a feast day, and they will confound all the days, the holy with the unclean, and the unclean day with the holy; for they will go wrong as to the months and sabbaths and feasts and jubilees. For this reason I command and testify to you that you may testify to them; for after your death your children will disturb (them), so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only, and for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and sabbaths and festivals, and they will eat all kinds of blood with all kinds of flesh.* Jubilees even ends with Enoch's exact pairing — going wrong as to new moons, seasons, sabbaths and festivals, and eating blood with all kinds of flesh (81:7).
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:37 — *For this reason the years will come upon them when they will disturb (the order), and make an abominable (day) the day of testimony, and an unclean day a feast day, and they will confound all the days, the holy with the unclean, and the unclean day with the holy; for they will go wrong as to the months and sabbaths and feasts and jubilees. For this reason I command and testify to you that you may testify to them; for after your death your children will disturb (them), so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only, and for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and sabbaths and festivals, and they will eat all kinds of blood with all kinds of flesh.* Jubilees names what Enoch foresaw — the chiefs of the stars transgressing their order and not appearing at the seasons prescribed (80:6) — and adds the result among men: going wrong as to new moons, seasons, sabbaths and festivals, and eating blood with all kinds of flesh.
cards.live_text: And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:34 — *And all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) will forget, and will not find the path of the years, and will forget the new moons, and seasons, and sabbaths, and they will go wrong as to all the order of the years.* Jubilees describes the identical drift Enoch foretells in 81:7 — forgetting the new moons, seasons and sabbaths of the 364-day order.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:34 — *And all the children of Yashar'el (Israel) will forget, and will not find the path of the years, and will forget the new moons, and seasons, and sabbaths, and they will go wrong as to all the order of the years.* Jubilees describes the identical drift Enoch foretells — men at fault, not reckoning the days accurately in the whole reckoning of the year (82:5) — forgetting the new moons, seasons and sabbaths of the 364-day order.
cards.live_text: Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the whole reckoning of the year: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.

cards.old_note: Daniel 7:25 — *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* To alter the times and the festivals (81:7) is to do the work of the horn who thinks to change times and laws.
cards.new_note: Daniel 7:25 — *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* To alter the orbits and seasons prescribed (80:6) is the work of the horn who thinks to change times and laws.
cards.live_text: And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.

cards.old_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The times, seasons, new moons and festivals the perverse generation alters (81:7) are fixed by the luminaries at creation, not by men.
cards.new_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The times and seasons were written into creation by the lights; in the days of the sinners all things on the earth alter and do not appear in their time (80:2) — the order violated, not rewritten by men.
cards.live_text: And in the days of the sinners the years shall be shortened, And their seed shall be tardy on their lands and fields, And all things on the earth shall alter, And shall not appear in their time: And the rain shall be kept back And the heaven shall withhold (it).

cards.old_note: Psalm 1:1 — *Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.* Enoch's few righteous who refuse the paths of unrighteousness (81:9) are the blessed man of the two ways who will not walk in the counsel of the ungodly.
cards.new_note: Psalm 1:1 — *Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.* Enoch's righteous who die on account of the deeds of men and are taken away because of the doings of the godless (81:9) are the blessed man of the two ways — the one who would not walk in the counsel of the ungodly, and paid for it.
cards.live_text: And those who practise righteousness shall die on account of the deeds of men, And be taken away on account of the doings of the godless.’

cards.old_note: Leviticus 23:2 — *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* To complete the years in truth (81:10) is to keep the feasts that are Yahuah's own appointed times, fixed by the lights.
cards.new_note: Leviticus 23:2 — *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* Blessed are those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners in the reckoning of all their days (82:4) — to keep the count is to keep the feasts that are Yahuah's (the LORD's) own appointed times, fixed by the lights.
cards.live_text: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.

cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:38 — *...they will go wrong as to the months and sabbaths and feasts and jubilees. For this reason I command and testify to you that you may testify to them; for after your death your children will disturb (them), so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only, and for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and sabbaths and festivals, and they will eat all kinds of blood with all kinds of flesh.* Jubilees and Enoch describe the same coming apostasy from the reckoning: men at fault, not reckoning the days in the whole reckoning of the year (82:5) — Jubilees adds the going wrong as to new moons, sabbaths and feasts, down to eating blood with flesh.
cards.live_text: Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the whole reckoning of the year: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.

cards.old_note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* Perverting the order of the lights bends men toward the host-of-heaven idolatry Torah forbade.
cards.new_note: Deuteronomy 4:19 — *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* When the order of the lights is concealed from the sinners they err and take them to be gods (80:7) — the host-of-heaven idolatry Torah forbade.
cards.live_text: And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.

cards.old_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The new moons and seasons that sinners try to alter are appointed by the luminaries themselves.
cards.new_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The new moons and seasons men fail to reckon accurately (82:5) are appointed by the luminaries themselves.
cards.live_text: Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the whole reckoning of the year: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.

cards.old_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* the times and seasons the sinners alter were written into creation by the lights, not invented by men.
cards.new_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The year completed in three hundred and sixty-four days, truly recorded for ever (82:6), is the Genesis decree of lights for days and years worked out in full.
cards.live_text: For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.

cards.old_note: Daniel 7:25 — *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* Enoch's sinners who "alter the times, and the seasons" are Daniel's horn that thinks to change times and laws.
cards.new_note: Daniel 7:25 — *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* Enoch's sinners from whom the order of the stars is concealed, who err about the times (80:7), are Daniel's horn that thinks to change times and laws.
cards.live_text: And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.

cards.old_note: Leviticus 23:4 — *These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.* To "complete their years in truth" is to keep the appointed feasts in their seasons, as the lights ordain them.
cards.new_note: Leviticus 23:4 — *These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.* Blessed are those who sin not as the sinners in the reckoning of all their days (82:4) — to keep the count right is to keep the appointed feasts in their seasons, as the lights ordain them.
cards.live_text: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.

cards.old_note: Psalm 1:2 — *But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law doth he meditate day and night.* The blessed keep the commandments of Yahuah of Spirits because their delight is in His law.
cards.new_note: Psalm 1:2 — *But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law doth he meditate day and night.* The blessed walk in the way of righteousness and keep the reckoning of their days (82:4) because their delight is in his law.
cards.live_text: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.

cards.old_note: Psalm 1:1 — *Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.* Enoch's "blessed are those who keep the commandments... and walk in righteousness" is the blessing of the man who does not walk in the way of sinners.
cards.new_note: Psalm 1:1 — *Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.* Enoch's *blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners* (82:4) is the blessing of the man who does not walk in the way of sinners.
cards.live_text: Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts...* The law of the luminaries Enoch writes on the heavenly tablets is the same 364-day reckoning Jubilees commands Israel to keep.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts...* The reckoning Enoch records as true for ever — the year completed in three hundred and sixty-four days (82:6) — is the same count Jubilees commands Israel to keep.
cards.live_text: For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.

cards.old_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The earth does not alter her seasons because the moon and sun keep their appointed courses.
cards.new_note: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The seasons do not shift because the reckoning of the luminaries is exact and recorded (82:7); the moon and sun keep the courses they were appointed.
cards.live_text: And the account thereof is accurate and the recorded reckoning thereof exact; for the luminaries, and months and festivals, and years and days, has Uriel shown and revealed to me, to whom Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the world hath subjected the host of heaven.

cards.old_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* the luminaries do not alter their courses because their Maker fixed them for signs and seasons from creation.
cards.new_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The luminaries do not alter their courses because their Maker fixed them for signs and seasons from creation — the exact account Uriel showed Enoch (82:7).
cards.live_text: And the account thereof is accurate and the recorded reckoning thereof exact; for the luminaries, and months and festivals, and years and days, has Uriel shown and revealed to me, to whom Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the world hath subjected the host of heaven.

cards.old_note: Jubilees 6:17 — *For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year...* The feasts governed by Enoch's leaders of the seasons are the heavenly-tablet appointments by which the covenant is renewed.
cards.new_note: Jubilees 6:17 — *For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year...* The feasts governed by Enoch's leaders of the four parts of the year and the twelve orders of the months (82:11) are the heavenly-tablet appointments by which the covenant is renewed.
cards.live_text: Their four leaders who divide the four parts of the year enter first; and after them the twelve leaders of the orders who divide the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days) there are heads over thousands who divide the days; and for the four intercalary days there are the leaders which sunder the four parts of the year.

cards.old_note: Leviticus 23:2 — *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* The chiefs of the four quarters and the feasts Enoch numbers are the appointed feasts of Yahuah, proclaimed by the lights.
cards.new_note: Leviticus 23:2 — *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* The leaders who divide the four parts of the year and the months (82:11) mark the appointed feasts of Yahuah (LORD), proclaimed by the lights.
cards.live_text: Their four leaders who divide the four parts of the year enter first; and after them the twelve leaders of the orders who divide the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days) there are heads over thousands who divide the days; and for the four intercalary days there are the leaders which sunder the four parts of the year.

cards.old_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* the leaders of the stars who do not transgress their commandments keep the very signs and seasons set at creation.
cards.new_note: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The leaders who divide the parts of the year, the months and the days (82:11) keep the very signs and seasons set at creation.
cards.live_text: Their four leaders who divide the four parts of the year enter first; and after them the twelve leaders of the orders who divide the months; and for the three hundred and sixty (days) there are heads over thousands who divide the days; and for the four intercalary days there are the leaders which sunder the four parts of the year.

cards.old_note: Genesis 7:11 — *In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.* The broken-up deep is the great abyss that swallows the earth in Enoch's vision (83:5).
cards.new_note: Genesis 7:11 — *In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.* The broken-up deep is the great abyss that swallows the earth in Enoch's vision (83:4).
cards.live_text: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.

cards.old_note: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The violence that fills the earth is the corruption Enoch sees punished when the earth is swallowed in the abyss at 83:5.
cards.new_note: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The violence that fills the earth is the corruption Enoch sees punished when the earth is swallowed in the abyss at 83:4.
cards.live_text: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.

cards.old_note: 2 Peter 3:11 — *Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness.* Peter turns the dissolving earth of Enoch's vision (83:6) toward holy living, not toward law-as-curse.
cards.new_note: 2 Peter 3:11 — *Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness.* Peter turns the earth Enoch saw sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction (83:7) toward holy living, not toward law-as-curse.
cards.live_text: And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said unto me: ‘A terrible thing hast thou seen, my son, and of grave moment is thy dream-vision as to the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.

cards.old_note: Matthew 24:37 — *But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* Yahusha makes the Flood Enoch sees in his vision (83:6) the very type of the coming of the Son of Adam.
cards.new_note: Matthew 24:37 — *But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* Yahusha (Jesus) makes the flood Mahalalel reads in Enoch's dream — the earth sinking into the abyss for the sin of the earth (83:7) — the type of the coming of the Son of Adam.
cards.live_text: And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said unto me: ‘A terrible thing hast thou seen, my son, and of grave moment is thy dream-vision as to the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.

cards.old_note: Matthew 24:39 — *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The Flood that takes all away is Enoch's "all that was upon the earth perished" (83:7), made the figure of the last day.
cards.new_note: Matthew 24:39 — *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The flood that takes all away is the great destruction Mahalalel names over Enoch's dream — the earth sinking into the abyss (83:7) — made the figure of the last day.
cards.live_text: And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said unto me: ‘A terrible thing hast thou seen, my son, and of grave moment is thy dream-vision as to the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.

cards.old_note: Genesis 7:23 — *And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.* Enoch's "all that was upon the earth perished" (83:7) is the deluge that left only Noah's house alive.
cards.new_note: Genesis 7:23 — *And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.* The earth destroyed with a great destruction for the sin of the earth (83:7) is the deluge that left only Noah's house alive.
cards.live_text: And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said unto me: ‘A terrible thing hast thou seen, my son, and of grave moment is thy dream-vision as to the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.

cards.old_note: Genesis 6:13 — *And Elohim (God) said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.* Enoch's "all that was upon the earth perished" (83:7) is this very decree against all flesh.
cards.new_note: Genesis 6:13 — *And Elohim (God) said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.* The sin of the earth that sinks it into the abyss (83:7) is this very decree against all flesh.
cards.live_text: And I recounted to him the whole vision which I had seen, and he said unto me: ‘A terrible thing hast thou seen, my son, and of grave moment is thy dream-vision as to the secrets of all the sin of the earth: it must sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction.

cards.old_note: Genesis 8:1 — *And Elohim (God) remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and Elohim (God) made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged.* The remembering of Noah is the answer to Enoch's prayer that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:9) — a seed preserved through the waters.
cards.new_note: Genesis 8:1 — *And Elohim (God) remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and Elohim (God) made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged.* The remembering of Noah is the answer to Enoch's prayer that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:8) — a seed preserved through the waters.
cards.live_text: And now, my son, arise and make petition to Yahuah (Lord) of glory, since thou art a believer, that a remnant may remain on the earth, and that He may not destroy the whole earth.

cards.old_note: Amos 7:6 — *Yahuah (LORD) repented for this: This also shall not be, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).* Yahuah relents at the prophet's plea, the very answer Enoch's intercession seeks when he prays the earth be spared (83:9).
cards.new_note: Amos 7:6 — *Yahuah (LORD) repented for this: This also shall not be, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).* Yahuah relents at the prophet's plea, the very answer Enoch's intercession seeks when he prays the earth be spared (83:8).
cards.live_text: And now, my son, arise and make petition to Yahuah (Lord) of glory, since thou art a believer, that a remnant may remain on the earth, and that He may not destroy the whole earth.

cards.old_note: Amos 7:5 — *Then said I, O Yahuah (Lord) GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.* The prophet's intercession for the small remnant echoes Enoch praying that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:9).
cards.new_note: Amos 7:5 — *Then said I, O Yahuah (Lord) GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.* The prophet's intercession for the small remnant echoes Enoch praying that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:8).
cards.live_text: And now, my son, arise and make petition to Yahuah (Lord) of glory, since thou art a believer, that a remnant may remain on the earth, and that He may not destroy the whole earth.

cards.old_note: Revelation 6:14 — *And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.* The sixth seal repeats Enoch's scroll-rolled heaven (83:10) and the mountains displaced from his vision (83:5).
cards.new_note: Revelation 6:14 — *And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.* The sixth seal's mountains and islands moved out of their places is Enoch's dream — mountains suspended on mountains, hills sinking on hills, as the earth is swallowed in the abyss (83:4).
cards.live_text: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.

cards.old_note: Isaiah 34:4 — *And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.* Enoch's heaven "rolled up like a scroll" with the luminaries falling (83:10) is Isaiah's Day-of-Yahuah unmaking of the host of heaven.
cards.new_note: Isaiah 34:4 — *And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.* Isaiah's unmaking on the Day of Yahuah (the LORD) — the host falling as leaves from the vine — is the unmaking Enoch dreamed: the earth swallowed in the abyss and the mountains hurled down (83:4).
cards.live_text: And when it fell to the earth I saw how the earth was swallowed up in a great abyss, and mountains were suspended on mountains, and hills sank down on hills, and high trees were rent from their stems, and hurled down and sunk in the abyss.

cards.old_note: Exodus 3:8 — *And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey...* The Lord of the sheep coming down to deliver from the wolves (89:19) is Yahuah come down to deliver Israel.
cards.new_note: Exodus 3:8 — *And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey...* The Lord of the sheep descending at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode and pasturing them (89:16) is Yahuah (LORD) come down to deliver Israel.
cards.live_text: And a sheep which had been saved from the wolves fled and escaped to the wild asses; and I saw the sheep how they lamented and cried, and besought their Lord with all their might, till that Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep descended at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode, and came to them and pastured them.

cards.old_note: Exodus 19:4 — *Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.* The Lord bringing the saved sheep out from among the wolves to Himself (89:16,19) is Yahuah bearing Israel on eagles' wings to Himself.
cards.new_note: Exodus 19:4 — *Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.* The Lord of the sheep coming down to the sheep that cried to him (89:16) is Yahuah (LORD) bearing Israel on eagles' wings to himself.
cards.live_text: And a sheep which had been saved from the wolves fled and escaped to the wild asses; and I saw the sheep how they lamented and cried, and besought their Lord with all their might, till that Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep descended at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode, and came to them and pastured them.

cards.old_note: Exodus 14:21 — *And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.* The wolves pursuing the fleeing sheep (89:18) is Pharaoh's pursuit broken at the divided sea.
cards.new_note: Exodus 14:21 — *And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.* The wolves pursuing the sheep till they reached a sea of water (89:23) is Pharaoh's pursuit broken at the divided sea.
cards.live_text: But the wolves began to pursue those sheep till they reached a sea of water.

cards.old_note: Exodus 14:28 — *And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.* The Lord of the sheep delivering it from the wolves (89:19) is the host of Pharaoh drowned in the returning sea.
cards.new_note: Exodus 14:28 — *And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.* The sea gathering itself together and rising till it covered the wolves (89:26) is the host of Pharaoh drowned in the returning sea.
cards.live_text: And when they saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep, they turned to flee before His face, but that sea gathered itself together, and became as it had been created, and the water swelled and rose till it covered those wolves.

cards.old_note: Exodus 14:30 — *Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.* The Lord of the sheep heard its cry and delivered it from the wolves (89:19) — Yahuah Himself saved Israel out of Egypt's hand.
cards.new_note: Exodus 14:30 — *Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.* All the wolves who pursued the sheep perished and were drowned (89:27) — Yahuah (LORD) himself saved Israel out of Egypt's hand.
cards.live_text: And I saw till all the wolves who pursued those sheep perished and were drowned.

cards.old_note: Exodus 19:18 — *And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.* The eyes of all the sheep opened to glorify the Lord of the sheep (89:23) is the flock at Sinai where Yahuah descended in fire.
cards.new_note: Exodus 19:18 — *And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.* The Lord of the sheep standing before them, great and terrible and majestic, so that all the sheep were afraid before his face (89:30), is Sinai, where Yahuah (LORD) descended in fire.
cards.live_text: And after that I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep who stood before them, and His appearance was great and terrible and majestic, and all those sheep saw Him and were afraid before His face.

cards.old_note: Exodus 24:8 — *And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.* The sheep speaking together and glorifying Yahuah (God) of Spirits (89:23) is the people sealed under the blood of the covenant.
cards.new_note: Exodus 24:8 — *And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.* The sheep whose eyes began to open in the wilderness, pastured by the Lord of the sheep himself (89:28), are the people brought to the covenant he would seal with blood.
cards.live_text: But the sheep escaped from that water and went forth into a wilderness, where there was no water and no grass; and they began to open their eyes and to see; and I saw Yahuah (Lord) of the sheep pasturing them and giving them water and grass, and that sheep going and leading them.

cards.old_note: Ezekiel 34:5 — *And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.* The beasts and birds devouring the sheep (89:34) is Ezekiel's flock made meat to the beasts of the field.
cards.new_note: Ezekiel 34:5 — *And they were scattered, because there is no shepherd: and they became meat to all the beasts of the field, when they were scattered.* The wild beasts tearing the sheep in pieces (89:55) is Ezekiel's flock made meat to the beasts of the field.
