cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* The rich confess at the judgement that their wealth could not save them, the very helplessness Enoch foretells in the day of affliction (94:5).

Psalm 49:7 — *None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:* riches cannot ransom a man in the day of affliction, exactly as Enoch says they 'shall not deliver you' (94:5).
cards.new_note: Psalm 49:7 — *None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:* Riches cannot ransom a man — exactly what Enoch says the children of the earth will come to recognize: *their riches shall not be able to save them in the overthrow of their sins* (100:6).
cards.live_text: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.

cards.live_text: Woe to you who work godlessness, And glory in lying and extol them: Ye shall perish, and no happy life shall be yours.

cards.old_note: Isaiah 5:20 — *Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!* — Isaiah's woe against inverting the moral order is Enoch's woe on those who alter the words of uprightness and write unrighteousness in 95:2.
cards.new_note: Isaiah 5:20 — *Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!* Isaiah's woe against inverting the moral order is Enoch's woe on those who pervert the words of uprightness and transgress the eternal law (99:2).
cards.live_text: Woe to them who pervert the words of uprightness, And transgress the eternal law, And transform themselves into what they were not [into sinners]: They shall be trodden under foot upon the earth.

cards.old_note: Amos 5:11 — *Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.* The prophet's word for the very treading-and-feasting Enoch condemns in 96:1, and the houses the oppressors shall not keep.
cards.new_note: Amos 5:11 — *Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.* The prophet's word for the very treading-and-feasting Enoch condemns in 96:5, and the houses the oppressors shall not keep.
cards.live_text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

cards.old_note: Isaiah 3:14 — *Yahuah (LORD) will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.* Those who devour the might of others and eat the best food (96:1) are the very princes who have eaten up the vineyard.
cards.new_note: Isaiah 3:14 — *Yahuah (LORD) will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.* Those who devour the might of others and eat the best food (96:5) are the very princes who have eaten up the vineyard.
cards.live_text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

cards.old_note: Luke 6:24 — *But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.* Yahusha's woe on the rich is the same sentence Enoch pronounces on the mighty in unrighteousness whose might shall be cut off (96:2).
cards.new_note: Luke 6:24 — *But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) woe on the rich is the sentence Enoch pronounces on the mighty who oppress the righteous with their might: *the day of your destruction is coming* (96:8).
cards.live_text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

cards.old_note: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens his woe on the rich exactly where Enoch does — the mighty in unrighteousness facing the cutting-off of their might (96:2).
cards.new_note: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens his woe on the rich where Enoch does — the mighty who oppress the righteous, whose day of destruction is coming (96:8).
cards.live_text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

cards.old_note: James 5:3 — *Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.* The cankering of hoarded wealth is how James shows the might cut off that Enoch warns of in 96:2.
cards.new_note: James 5:3 — *Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.* The cankering of hoarded wealth is how James shows the day of destruction Enoch warns the mighty of (96:8).
cards.live_text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

cards.old_note: Luke 6:25 — *Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.* Nearly verbatim with Enoch 96:3 — the full shall be hungry and thirst.
cards.new_note: Luke 6:25 — *Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) woe on the full is Enoch's woe on those who devour the finest of the wheat and drink wine in large bowls while treading the lowly under foot (96:5).
cards.live_text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* Wisdom voices the doomed rich confessing the emptiness of the fatness Enoch says shall turn to hunger (96:3).
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* Wisdom voices the doomed rich confessing the emptiness of their feasting — the finest of the wheat and the wine in large bowls Enoch's woe names (96:5).
cards.live_text: Woe to you who devour the finest of the wheat, And drink wine in large bowls, And tread under foot the lowly with your might.

cards.old_note: Luke 12:18 — *And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.* The rich fool's brimming barns are the very granaries Enoch's hoarders boast of in 96:7.
cards.new_note: Luke 12:18 — *And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.* The rich fool's brimming barns are the very granaries Enoch's hoarders boast of in 97:9.
cards.live_text: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,

cards.old_note: Amos 8:6 — *That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?* The wheat hoarded in Enoch's full granaries (96:7) is the same refuse Amos says was sold by defrauding the needy.
cards.new_note: Amos 8:6 — *That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?* The wheat hoarded in Enoch's full granaries (97:9) is the same refuse Amos says was sold by defrauding the needy.
cards.live_text: And now let us do what we purposed: For we have gathered silver, And many are the husbandmen in our houses.’ And our granaries are (brim) full as with water,

cards.old_note: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The many labourers of Enoch 96:8 are James' reapers whose withheld wages cry to Yahuah of hosts.
cards.new_note: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The mighty who oppress the righteous with their might (96:8) are James's rich men whose withheld wages cry to Yahuah (Lord) of hosts.
cards.live_text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

cards.old_note: Ecclesiasticus 34:22 — *He that takes away his neighbour's living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.* Ben Sira makes defrauding the many labourers of Enoch 96:8 a deed of blood, the very crime drawing the woe.
cards.new_note: Ecclesiasticus 34:22 — *He that takes away his neighbour's living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.* Ben Sira makes defrauding the labourer a deed of blood — the oppression of the righteous by might that Enoch's woe names (96:8).
cards.live_text: Woe to you, ye mighty, Who with might oppress the righteous; For the day of your destruction is coming. In those days many and good days shall come to the righteous—in the day of your judgement.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:1 — *...and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Enoch's separation of righteous from sinners (102:1-2) is Daniel's deliverance — the deciding line is the name already written, election before any confession.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:1 — *...and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* When he brings a grievous fire and there is nowhere to flee (102:1), Daniel's deliverance belongs to every one found written in the book — the deciding line is the name already written, election before any confession.
cards.live_text: In those days when He hath brought a grievous fire upon you, Whither will ye flee, and where will ye find deliverance? And when He launches forth His word against you Will you not be affrighted and fear?

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:2 — *In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,* matching the very taunt Enoch's sinners raise at 102:5-6 — the world reads the righteous death as defeat and cannot see the path that runs through it.
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:2 — *In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,* Wisdom's unwise who take the righteous death for misery are Enoch's sinners speaking over the righteous dead — *as we die, so die the righteous, and what benefit do they reap for their deeds?* (102:6). The world reads that death as defeat and cannot see the path that runs through it.
cards.live_text: And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you: ‘As we die, so die the righteous, And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The separation of the righteous dead from the sinners in Enoch 102:2 is the two-fold awakening — life for the one, shame for the other.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The division made in Sheol between the spirits of the righteous and the rest (22:9) is Daniel's two-fold awakening — life for the one, shame for the other.
cards.live_text: And he answered me and said unto me: ‘These three have been made that the spirits of the dead might be separated. And such a division has been made for the spirits of the righteous, in which there is the bright spring of water.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The no-torment promise of Enoch 102:3 is the hope of immortality — the righteous suffer in the world's eyes but are kept whole in Elohim's hand.
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope full of immortality is Enoch's word to the righteous dead: fear not, and be hopeful, ye that have died in righteousness (102:4) — punished in the world's eyes, kept whole before him.
cards.live_text: Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous, And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* Almost verbatim with Enoch 102:3 — the righteous dead rest in Elohim's hand, untouched by torment, while only the sinners are held in Sheol.
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* Wisdom's souls of the righteous in the hand of Elohim (God) are the souls Enoch tells not to fear, that have died in righteousness (102:4) — grieve not that the body went into Sheol; wait for the day.
cards.live_text: Fear ye not, ye souls of the righteous, And be hopeful ye that have died in righteousness.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:3 — *And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:* the mockers of Enoch 102:6 (“these are they who have despised us”) seen now from the other side — the despisers confessing too late.
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:3 — *And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:* The mockers who spoke over the righteous dead — *as we die, so die the righteous* (102:6) — seen now from the other side: the despisers confessing too late.
cards.live_text: And yet when ye die the sinners speak over you: ‘As we die, so die the righteous, And what benefit do they reap for their deeds?

cards.old_note: Malachi 4:2 — *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.* The righteous shining like the sun in Enoch 102:7 meet the Sun of righteousness who rises for those who fear Yahuah's name — the other end from the furnace.
cards.new_note: Malachi 4:2 — *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.* The righteous in the light of the sun, the elect in the light of eternal life (58:3), meet the Sun of righteousness who rises for those who fear Yahuah's (the LORD's) name — the other end from the furnace.
cards.live_text: And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.

cards.old_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:5 — *How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!* The sinners' astonishment at the shining righteous in Enoch 102:7 is this very cry — the despised are found among the elect.
cards.new_note: Wisdom of Solomon 5:5 — *How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!* The righteous shining as the lights of heaven, seen at last with the portals of heaven opened to them (104:2), is this very cry — the despised found among the elect.
cards.live_text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

cards.old_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha's own words for the harvest's end exactly render Enoch 102:7 — the righteous shining like the sun.
cards.new_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) own words for the harvest's end render Enoch's close: those born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent (108:14).
cards.live_text: And they shall see those who were born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* Enoch's righteous *shining like the sun* (102:7) is Daniel's resurrection-radiance of the wise.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* Enoch's righteous who shall shine as the lights of heaven (104:2) are Daniel's resurrection-radiance of the wise.
cards.live_text: Be hopeful; for aforetime ye were put to shame through ill and affliction; but now ye shall shine as the lights of heaven, ye shall shine and ye shall be seen, and the portals of heaven shall be opened to you.

cards.old_note: Revelation 14:13 — *And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in Yahuah (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.* The blessing on the righteous dead, whose names stand in the books of life (103:3).
cards.new_note: Revelation 14:13 — *And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in Yahusha (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.* The blessing on the righteous dead — all goodness and joy and glory prepared and written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness (103:3).
cards.live_text: That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness, And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.

cards.old_note: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where Enoch sees the righteous already written (103:3).
cards.new_note: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where Enoch sees goodness and glory written down for the spirits of those who died in righteousness (103:3).
cards.live_text: That all goodness and joy and glory are prepared for them, And written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness, And that manifold good shall be given to you in recompense for your labours, And that your lot is abundantly beyond the lot of the living.

cards.old_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha confirms the same shining of the righteous Enoch promises under oath.
cards.new_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha (Jesus) confirms what Enoch promises under oath: the spirits of those who died in righteousness shall live and rejoice and their memorial shall not perish (103:4) — the righteous shining in the Father's kingdom.
cards.live_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The light Yahuah causes to appear on Enoch's righteous (103:4) is Daniel's firmament-shining.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The spirits of the righteous dead that shall live and rejoice before the face of the Great One (103:4) are Daniel's wise, shining as the firmament.
cards.live_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening Daniel sees is the very life Enoch swears the righteous spirits shall not lose.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening Daniel sees is the very life Enoch swears the righteous spirits shall not lose (103:4).
cards.live_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.old_note: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope full of immortality is the satisfied life Enoch swears the righteous shall have (103:7).
cards.new_note: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope full of immortality is the life Enoch swears the righteous dead shall have — their spirits shall live and rejoice and not perish (103:4).
cards.live_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.old_note: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* The same safekeeping of the righteous spirits that Enoch swears shall not perish.
cards.new_note: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* The same safekeeping of the righteous spirits: they shall live and rejoice, and their memorial shall not perish from before the face of the Great One (103:4).
cards.live_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.old_note: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The end of the names found in the books of the unrighteous that Enoch witnesses opened (103:9).
cards.new_note: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The end of those whose names are blotted out of the book of life (108:3): their seed destroyed, their spirits slain, and the fire — the same end for the unwritten.
cards.live_text: And wait ye indeed till sin has passed away, for their names shall be blotted out of the book of life and out of the holy books, and their seed shall be destroyed for ever, and their spirits shall be slain, and they shall cry and make lamentation in a place that is a chaotic wilderness, and in the fire shall they burn; for there is no earth there.

cards.old_note: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The same opening of the books of the living and of the unrighteous that Enoch witnesses (103:9).
cards.new_note: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The sinners say their sins will not be searched out and written down; Enoch answers that they are written down every day (104:7). John's opened books are those records.
cards.live_text: And, although ye sinners say: “All our sins shall not be searched out and be written down,” nevertheless they shall write down all your sins every day.

cards.old_note: Luke 16:24 — *And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.* The cry from Sheol that Enoch says shall not be heard nor ascend to heaven (103:10-11).
cards.new_note: Luke 16:24 — *And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.* The cry from the flame is the cry Enoch hears from the darkness and chains and burning flame where the sinners' spirits enter (103:8).
cards.live_text: And into darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgement shall your spirits enter; And the great judgement shall be for all the generations of the world. Woe to you, for ye shall have no peace.

cards.old_note: Luke 16:23 — *And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.* The torment-side of Sheol where Enoch sees the sinners' spirits cast into darkness (103:10).
cards.new_note: Luke 16:23 — *And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.* The torment-side of Sheol is the darkness and chains and burning flame where Enoch says the sinners' spirits enter, where there is grievous judgment (103:8).
cards.live_text: And into darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgement shall your spirits enter; And the great judgement shall be for all the generations of the world. Woe to you, for ye shall have no peace.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Deliverance belongs to every one written in the book — Enoch's elect whose names stand before the Most High.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Deliverance belongs to every one written in the book — Enoch's righteous whose names are written before the glory of the Great One (104:1).
cards.live_text: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.

cards.old_note: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where the righteous names of 104:3 are written before the Most High.
cards.new_note: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where the names of the righteous are written before the glory of the Great One (104:1).
cards.live_text: I swear unto you, that in heaven the angels remember you for good before the glory of the Great One: and your names are written before the glory of the Great One.

cards.old_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha seals Enoch's promise: the righteous shine in the Father's kingdom.
cards.new_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha (Jesus) seals Enoch's promise: the righteous shine in the Father's kingdom — great joy as the angels of heaven (104:4).
cards.live_text: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* Yahuah causing His light to appear on the righteous (104:4) is Daniel's wise shining as the firmament.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The great joy as the angels of heaven Enoch promises the righteous (104:4) is Daniel's wise shining as the firmament.
cards.live_text: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening of the dust-sleepers is the very resurrection Enoch promises the righteous in 104:2-5.
cards.new_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening of the dust-sleepers is the very resurrection Enoch promises the righteous in 104:2–5 — hope not cast away, joy as the angels (104:4).
cards.live_text: Be hopeful, and cast not away your hope; for ye shall have great joy as the angels of heaven.

cards.old_note: the Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The same extra-canonical resurrection-shining: the righteous vindicated and luminous at their visitation.
cards.new_note: the Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* Wisdom's righteous shining at their visitation are Enoch's righteous who will not have to hide on the day of the great judgment and will not be found as sinners (104:5).
cards.live_text: What shall ye be obliged to do? Ye shall not have to hide on the day of the great judgement and ye shall not be found as sinners, and the eternal judgement shall be far from you for all the generations of the world.

cards.old_note: Revelation 3:5 — *He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.* Yahusha's promise not to blot the overcomer's name is Enoch's name that shall not be blotted out.
cards.new_note: Revelation 3:5 — *He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) promise not to blot the overcomer's name is Enoch's memorial that shall not perish from before the face of the Great One (103:4).
cards.live_text: And the spirits of you who have died in righteousness shall live and rejoice, And their spirits shall not perish, nor their memorial from before the face of the Great One Unto all the generations of the world: wherefore no longer fear their contumely.

cards.new_note: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* John's opened books are the records Enoch names: all your oppression written down every day till the day of your judgment (98:8).

cards.new_note: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The fire that receives the unwritten is the darkness and chains and burning flame Enoch's sinners enter, where there is grievous judgment (103:8).

cards.old_note: James 5:5 — *Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.* James condemns the same self-indulgent feasting on the backs of others that Enoch pronounces woe upon (94:18).

cards.old_note: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* Daniel's two-fold awaking, to life or to shame, is Enoch's parting of the righteous made victorious from the sinners bound and cast into the furnace (38:12).

cards.live_text: With chains shall they be bound, And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.

cards.old_note: Exodus 3:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;* The Lord of the sheep who hears the sheep's cry (89:16,19) is Yahuah hearing Israel's cry in Egypt.
cards.new_note: Exodus 3:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;* The Lord of the sheep who hears the sheep's cry (89:16) is Yahuah hearing Israel's cry in Egypt.
cards.live_text: And the wolves began to fear them, and they oppressed them until they destroyed their little ones, and they cast their young into a river of much water: but those sheep began to cry aloud on account of their little ones, and to complain unto their Lord.

cards.old_note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* The shortening of days and the coming flood-judgement of Enoch 11 is the same sentence Yahuah pronounces in Genesis 6.
cards.new_note: Genesis 6:3 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also is flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.* Yahuah's (the LORD's) sentence that man's days be a hundred and twenty is of a piece with his word to Gabriel over the Watchers' children: *for length of days shall they not have* (10:9).
cards.live_text: And to Gabriel said Yahuah (Lord): ‘Proceed against the bastards and the reprobates, and against the children of fornication: and destroy [the children of fornication and] the children of the Watchers from amongst men [and cause them to go forth]: send them one against the other that they may destroy each other in battle: for length of days shall they not have.

cards.old_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha gives the same shining-righteous resurrection that closes Enoch's book.
cards.new_note: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha (Jesus) gives the righteous shining in their Father's kingdom; Enoch gives the children of the earth seeing the wise in security at last (100:6).
cards.live_text: And (then) the children of the earth shall see the wise in security, And shall understand all the words of this book, And recognize that their riches shall not be able to save them In the overthrow of their sins.

cards.old_note: Zechariah 4:7 — *Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.* The mountains made into a deep, wide, smooth valley to hold the elect is Zechariah's great mountain flattened to a plain before the chosen one.
cards.new_note: Zechariah 4:7 — *Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.* The valley filled with the elect and beloved when the days of leading astray are ended (56:4) is Zechariah's great mountain flattened to a plain before the chosen one.
cards.live_text: And then that valley shall be filled with their elect and beloved, And the days of their lives shall be at an end, And the days of their leading astray shall not thenceforward be reckoned.

cards.old_note: Revelation 6:15 — *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* The same kings and mighty of 53:3 flee, undone before the face from which they cannot be hidden.
cards.new_note: Revelation 6:15 — *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* The sinners destroyed before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and banished from his earth (53:2) are these kings and mighty men, undone before the face from which they cannot be hidden.
cards.live_text: And their hands commit lawless deeds, And the sinners devour all whom they lawlessly oppress: Yet the sinners shall be destroyed before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And they shall be banished from off the face of His earth, And they shall perish for ever and ever.

cards.old_note: Amos 6:7 — *Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.* — the banquet removed and the feasters led captive is the cutting-off of the rich oppressor's might in Enoch 95:4,7.

cards.old_note: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens the very woe Enoch pronounces on the rich whose glory shall not last (103:15, 24).
cards.new_note: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens the very woe Enoch pronounces on those who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness and say they have everything they desired (97:8).

cards.old_note: Luke 13:25 — *When once the master of the house is risen up, and hath shut to the door, and ye begin to stand without, and to knock at the door, saying, Yahuah (Lord), Yahuah (Lord), open unto us; and he shall answer and say unto you, I know you not whence ye are:* Yahusha's shut door is Enoch's pressed-out departure (63:4) — the petition is heard but the hour of mercy has passed.

cards.old_note: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The Son of Adam who casts down kings and kingdoms in Enoch 62:9-10 holds the everlasting dominion Daniel saw given to him by the Ancient of days.

members.old: Revelation 20:11 — *And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.* John's great white throne is the throne before which Enoch's Elect One appears and all the deeds of the sinners are revealed (38:3).
members.new: Revelation 20:11 — *And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away; and there was found no place for them.* The throne from whose face earth and heaven flee is the presence Enoch sees the godless driven from — away from the righteous and the elect (38:3).

members.old: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The books opened and the dead judged by their works is Enoch's scene where all the deeds of the sinners shall be revealed before Him (38:3).
members.new: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The books opened and the dead judged by their works is the hour Enoch names: the secrets of the righteous revealed and the sinners judged (38:3).

members.old: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* Daniel's two-fold awaking, to life or to shame, is Enoch's parting of the righteous made victorious from the sinners bound and cast into the furnace (38:12).
members.new: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* Daniel's two-fold awaking, to life or to shame, is Enoch's parting of the righteous made victorious from the sinners bound and cast into the furnace (69:28).

members.old: John 14:2 — *In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.* Yahusha names the very dwelling-places Enoch's spirit longed for in 1 Enoch 39:3, and says He goes ahead to prepare them.
members.new: John 14:2 — *In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.* Yahusha (Jesus) names the dwelling-places Enoch's spirit longed for — *there I wished to dwell, and my spirit longed for that dwelling-place* (39:8) — and says he goes ahead to prepare them.

members.old: Revelation 7:15 — *Therefore are they before the throne of Elohim (God), and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.* John sees the righteous lodged with the holy before the throne, the same resting-places among His angels that Enoch saw in 1 Enoch 39:4.
members.new: Revelation 7:15 — *Therefore are they before the throne of Elohim (God), and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.* John sees the righteous lodged with the holy before the throne, the same resting-places among His angels that Enoch saw in 1 Enoch 39:5.

members.old: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* The Father dwelling un-separated with His people in 1 Enoch 39:6 is the same tabernacling John hears announced over the renewed earth.
members.new: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* John hears the tabernacle of Elohim (God) with men; Enoch saw the Elect One of righteousness with the righteous and the elect without number before him for ever and ever (39:6).

members.old: Isaiah 42:1 — *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* Isaiah's "mine elect" is Enoch's "Elect One" of 1 Enoch 39:5 — the chosen Servant in whom the Father delights, on whom the Spirit rests.
members.new: Isaiah 42:1 — *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* Isaiah's *mine elect* is Enoch's *Mine Elect One* (45:3) — the chosen servant in whom the Father delights, set on the throne of glory.

members.old: Amos 5:24 — *But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.* Amos's flowing waters of righteousness are the very stream Enoch sees pour before the holy in 1 Enoch 39:4.
members.new: Amos 5:24 — *But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.* Amos's flowing waters of righteousness are the very stream Enoch sees pour before the holy in 1 Enoch 39:5.

members.old: Revelation 22:1 — *And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.* The water-like righteousness flowing in 1 Enoch 39:4 has its source in the river that proceeds from the throne of the Father and the Lamb.
members.new: Revelation 22:1 — *And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.* The water-like righteousness flowing in 1 Enoch 39:5 has its source in the river that proceeds from the throne of the Father and the Lamb.

members.old: Revelation 4:8 — *And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.* John's four living creatures praising ceaselessly about the throne are Enoch's four presences who surround the throne of glory and praise in 1 Enoch 39:11.
members.new: Revelation 4:8 — *And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.* John's four living creatures praising ceaselessly about the throne are Enoch's four presences who surround the throne of glory and praise in 1 Enoch 40:2.

members.old: Matthew 10:26 — *Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.* Yahusha's promise that every hidden thing shall be uncovered is the unsealing of the secrets to the righteous and elect at 40:17.
members.new: Matthew 10:26 — *Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) promise that every hidden thing shall be uncovered is Enoch's hour when the secrets of the righteous are revealed and the sinners judged (38:3).

members.old: 1 Timothy 2:5 — *For there is one Elohim (God), and one mediator between Elohim (God) and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);* No angel can intercede, says Enoch; the one mediator who can is not an angel but the Formed Son come in flesh.
members.new: 1 Timothy 2:5 — *For there is one Elohim (God), and one mediator between Elohim (God) and men, the man HaMashiach Yahusha (Christ Jesus);* No angel hinders, no power hinders; he judges them all before him (41:9). The one mediator between that judge and men is not an angel but the Formed Son come in flesh.

members.old: Hebrews 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* The intercession Enoch withholds from every angel is the living intercession the Son alone makes for those who come to the Father by Him.
members.new: Hebrews 7:25 — *Wherefore he is able also to save them to the uttermost that come unto Elohim (God) by him, seeing he ever liveth to make intercession for them.* Enoch is told no angel hinders and no power can — he himself appoints the judge and judges all (41:9). The intercession that reaches that throne is the Son's, who ever lives to make it for those who come to the Father by him.

members.old: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* He who judges all according to their deeds in Enoch is the One whose opened books judge the dead by their works.
members.new: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* He who judges them all before him in Enoch (41:9) is the One whose opened books judge the dead by their works.

members.old: Sirach 24:8 — *So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* Wisdom, denied a dwelling among men, is given her resting-place in Jacob — the elect with whom Yahuah of Spirits abides in Enoch 42:7-8.
members.new: Sirach 24:8 — *So the Creator of all things gave me a commandment, and he that made me caused my tabernacle to rest, and said, Let your dwelling be in Jacob, and your inheritance in Yashar'el (Israel).* Wisdom, denied a dwelling among men, is given her resting-place in Jacob — the elect over whom Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits abides and with whom the Son of Adam eats for ever (62:14).

members.old: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* Yahuah of Spirits abiding over His elect and dwelling with them in 42:8 is the tabernacle of Elohim finally set among His people.
members.new: Revelation 21:3 — *And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and Elohim (God) himself shall be with them, and be their Elohim (God).* Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits abiding over his elect, who eat and lie down and rise up with the Son of Adam for ever (62:14), is the tabernacle of Elohim (God) finally set among his people.

members.old: Psalm 114:4 — *The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.* The Exodus-redemption image of leaping hills is the exact figure Enoch uses in 42:9 for creation rejoicing as the righteous are made victorious.
members.new: Psalm 114:4 — *The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.* The Exodus-redemption image of leaping hills is the exact figure Enoch uses in 51:4 for creation rejoicing as the righteous are made victorious.

members.old: Job 38:35 — *Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?* Yahuah's challenge to Job names the same secret of lightning and thunder Enoch is shown in the storehouses of 44:1.
members.new: Job 38:35 — *Canst thou send lightnings, that they may go, and say unto thee, Here we are?* Yahuah's challenge to Job names the same secret of lightning and thunder Enoch is shown in the storehouses of 41:3.

members.old: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork* — the lights that praise and rest not before Yahuah of Spirits in 44:4 are the same unceasing witness the Psalm hears in the firmament.
members.new: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork* — the lights that praise and rest not before Yahuah of Spirits in 41:7 are the same unceasing witness the Psalm hears in the firmament.

members.old: Jubilees 2:9 — *And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years* — the monthly revolution of 44:4 is the very clockwork by which the moedim are appointed.
members.new: Jubilees 2:9 — *And Elohim (God) appointed the sun to be a great sign on the earth for days and for sabbaths and for months and for feasts and for years and for sabbaths of years and for jubilees and for all seasons of the years* — the monthly revolution of 41:7 is the very clockwork by which the moedim are appointed.

members.old: Genesis 1:4 — *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness* — the first division of creation is the pattern Enoch extends in 44:5 to the dividing of the spirits of men.
members.new: Genesis 1:4 — *And Elohim (God) saw the light, that it was good: and Elohim (God) divided the light from the darkness* The first division of creation is the pattern Enoch extends in 41:8 to the dividing of the spirits of men — the same one who separated light from darkness.

members.old: Genesis 1:18 — *And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good* — the luminaries themselves are the agents of the division Enoch names in 44:5, light to the righteous and darkness to the sinners.
members.new: Genesis 1:18 — *And to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness: and Elohim (God) saw that it was good* The luminaries themselves are the agents of the division Enoch names in 41:8 — light to the righteous and darkness to the sinners, in the name of him who divided the spirits of men.

members.old: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* Yahusha's furnace of fire for the wicked is the very furnace into which Enoch 45:6 casts the sinners.
members.new: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) furnace of fire for the wicked is the furnace of fire into which Enoch's sinners' spirits are cast, in shame and slaughter (98:3).

members.old: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* The righteous shining as the sun matches Enoch 45:9, the bright counterpart to the sinners-as-straw of 45:5-6.
members.new: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* The righteous shining in the kingdom of their Father are the righteous ones the Father has satisfied with peace and caused to dwell before him, while judgment waits for the sinners (45:6).

members.old: Malachi 4:1 — *For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.* The wicked as stubble in the burning day is Enoch 45:5's sinners as straw in the unquenchable fire.
members.new: Malachi 4:1 — *For, behold, the day cometh, that shall burn as an oven; and all the proud, yea, and all that do wickedly, shall be stubble: and the day that cometh shall burn them up, saith Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts), that it shall leave them neither root nor branch.* The wicked as stubble in the burning day is Enoch 48:9's sinners who burn as straw in the fire before the face of the holy, and leave no trace.

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The righteous flaming over the stubble is the bright reverse of Enoch 45:5, where the sinners themselves become the straw that burns.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The righteous flaming over the stubble is the bright reverse of Enoch 48:9, where the sinners themselves become the straw that burns.

members.old: Zechariah 4:7 — *Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.* The mountains made into a deep, wide, smooth valley to hold the elect is Zechariah's great mountain flattened to a plain before the chosen one.
members.new: Zechariah 4:7 — *Who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain: and he shall bring forth the headstone thereof with shoutings, crying, Grace, grace unto it.* The valley filled with the elect and beloved when the days of leading astray are ended (56:4) is Zechariah's great mountain flattened to a plain before the chosen one.

members.old: Isaiah 66:24 — *And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.* Isaiah names the same never-filled, never-quenched judgement on the transgressors that Enoch's bottomless valley holds.
members.new: Isaiah 66:24 — *And they shall go forth, and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me: for their worm shall not die, neither shall their fire be quenched; and they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.* Isaiah names the never-quenched judgment on the transgressors; Enoch saw the deep valley with open mouths that receives the homage of all the earth and never becomes full (53:1).

members.old: Isaiah 30:33 — *For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Yahuah (LORD), like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.* Isaiah's Tophet, prepared of old for the king, is the very deep furnace whose instruments the angels ready for the kings and mighty in 53:6.
members.new: Isaiah 30:33 — *For Tophet is ordained of old; yea, for the king it is prepared; he hath made it deep and large: the pile thereof is fire and much wood; the breath of Yahuah (LORD), like a stream of brimstone, doth kindle it.* Isaiah's Tophet, prepared of old for the king, is the very deep furnace whose instruments the angels ready for the kings and mighty in 53:5.

members.old: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* The furnace into which the workers of iniquity are cast is the destruction the instruments of 53:6 are prepared to accomplish.
members.new: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* The furnace into which the workers of iniquity are cast is the destruction the instruments of 53:5 are prepared to accomplish.

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 6:6 — *For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.* Wisdom weighs the sentence to the station exactly as 53:6 reserves the instruments for the kings, the mighty, and the exalted.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 6:6 — *For mercy will soon pardon the meanest: but mighty men shall be mightily tormented.* Wisdom weighs the sentence to the station exactly as 53:5 reserves the instruments for the kings, the mighty, and the exalted.

members.old: Revelation 19:20 — *These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.* The beast and false prophet — chief of the kings and mighty — are cast into the burning lake the instruments of 53:6 foretell.
members.new: Revelation 19:20 — *These both were cast alive into a lake of fire burning with brimstone.* The beast and false prophet — chief of the kings and mighty — are cast into the burning lake the instruments of 53:5 foretell.

members.old: Revelation 6:15 — *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* The same kings and mighty of 53:3 flee, undone before the face from which they cannot be hidden.
members.new: Revelation 6:15 — *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains;* The sinners destroyed before the face of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and banished from his earth (53:2) are these kings and mighty men, undone before the face from which they cannot be hidden.

members.old: Revelation 6:16 — *And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:* The sinners destroyed *before the face of Yahuah of Spirits* (53:3) are those who beg to be hidden from that very face.
members.new: Revelation 6:16 — *And said to the mountains and rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb:* The sinners destroyed *before the face of Yahuah of Spirits* (53:2) are those who beg to be hidden from that very face.

members.old: Isaiah 24:21 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* Isaiah joins the host above and the kings below under one judgement, as 53:3 banishes the oppressors from off the face of His earth.
members.new: Isaiah 24:21 — *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* Isaiah joins the host above and the kings below under one judgement, as 53:2 banishes the oppressors from off the face of His earth.

members.old: Isaiah 24:22 — *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* The pit-prison for the gathered transgressors mirrors the perishing for ever and ever of the sinners in 53:3.
members.new: Isaiah 24:22 — *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* The pit-prison for the gathered transgressors mirrors the perishing for ever and ever of the sinners in 53:2.

members.old: Job 38:25 — *Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;* the dividing of the lightning-and-thunder paths in 60:13 is Yahuah's own ordering of the storm in His answer to Job.
members.new: Job 38:25 — *Who hath divided a watercourse for the overflowing of waters, or a way for the lightning of thunder;* the dividing of the lightning-and-thunder paths in 41:3 is Yahuah's own ordering of the storm in His answer to Job.

members.old: Jeremiah 10:13 — *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.* The prophet confesses the same wind-out-of-the-treasuries order that the angel shows Enoch in the closed chambers of 60:14.
members.new: Jeremiah 10:13 — *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.* The prophet confesses the same wind-out-of-the-treasuries order that the angel shows Enoch in the closed chambers of 41:4.

members.old: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* The Head of Days who names and seats the Elect One in Enoch 62:1 is Daniel's Ancient of days who sits before any other throne is given.
members.new: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* The Head of Days who names and seats the Elect One in Enoch 61:8 is Daniel's Ancient of days who sits before any other throne is given.

members.old: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one *like* the Son of Adam brought near; Enoch 62:1 names that same One as the Elect One seated on the throne of glory — keep the 'like,' for he resembles mortal-man yet remains the Formed cloud-rider.
members.new: Daniel 7:13 — *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him.* Daniel sees one *like* the Son of Adam brought near; Enoch names that same One — *that Son of Adam sitting on the throne of his glory* (62:5). Keep the *like*: he resembles mortal man yet remains the Formed cloud-rider.

members.old: Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory.* The throne of His glory in Enoch 62:1 is the very throne where Yahusha, the Son of Adam, sits to sift the seed gathered out of all nations, the sheep from the goats.
members.new: Matthew 25:31 — *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory.* The throne of glory the kings see that Son of Adam sitting on (62:5) is the very throne where Yahusha (Jesus), the Son of Adam, sits to sift the seed gathered out of all nations, the sheep from the goats.

members.old: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* The judging 'by the way of the righteous judgement' in Enoch 62:2 is Isaiah's Branch who judges in righteousness, not by the sight of the eyes.
members.new: Isaiah 11:4 — *But with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth: and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth, and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.* The judging 'by the way of the righteous judgement' in Enoch 61:9 is Isaiah's Branch who judges in righteousness, not by the sight of the eyes.

members.old: Matthew 26:64 — *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* Yahusha owns the very title Enoch 62:7 records the Father speaking: 'This is the Son of Adam' — named, not merely likened.
members.new: Matthew 26:64 — *Yahusha (Jesus) saith unto him, Thou hast said: nevertheless I say unto you, Hereafter shall ye see the Son of Adam sitting on the right hand of power, and coming in the clouds of heaven.* Yahusha (Jesus) owns the very title the angel speaks over him in Enoch's vision: *This is the Son of Adam who is born unto righteousness* (71:14) — named, not merely likened.

members.old: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The Son of Adam who casts down kings and kingdoms in Enoch 62:9-10 holds the everlasting dominion Daniel saw given to him by the Ancient of days.
members.new: Daniel 7:14 — *And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all people, nations, and languages, should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.* The Son of Adam who casts down kings and kingdoms in Enoch 46:4-6 holds the everlasting dominion Daniel saw given to him by the Ancient of days.

members.old: Psalm 2:9 — *Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.* The Son of Adam who 'put down the kings from their thrones' in Enoch 62:10 is the Psalm's enthroned Son who breaks the raging rulers with the iron rod.
members.new: Psalm 2:9 — *Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.* The Son of Adam who 'put down the kings from their thrones' in Enoch 46:5 is the Psalm's enthroned Son who breaks the raging rulers with the iron rod.

members.old: Isaiah 45:23 — *I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.* The pride of the mighty abased in Enoch 62:11 ends where every knee bows before the throne of glory.
members.new: Isaiah 45:23 — *I have sworn by myself, the word is gone out of my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, That unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.* The pride of the mighty abased in Enoch 46:6 ends where every knee bows before the throne of glory.

members.old: Philippians 2:10 — *That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth.* Paul names the One before whom the proud of Enoch 62:11 are abased: Yahusha, the Son of Adam exalted by the Father.
members.new: Philippians 2:10 — *That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth.* Paul names the One before whom the proud of Enoch 46:6 are abased: Yahusha, the Son of Adam exalted by the Father.

members.new: Psalm 19:1 — *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* The positions and months of the luminaries Uriel showed Enoch and he wrote down (74:2) are the firmament preaching the Maker's handiwork.

members.old: Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* Jubilees names the same shortfall Enoch records — the lunar 354 against the solar 364, ten days short each year.
members.new: Jubilees 6:36 — *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* Jubilees names the same shortfall Enoch records — the moon falling behind the sun and the stars, six days every year, thirty in five (74:11). members.old: 1 Chronicles 27:1 — *Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.* The captains of thousands serving by months in Enoch 75:4 are mirrored on earth by Israel's monthly courses of captains of thousands — the heavenly ranks ordering time as the priestly ranks order service.
members.new: 1 Chronicles 27:1 — *Now the children of Yashar'el (Israel) after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.* The leaders of the heads of thousands set over the whole creation and the stars, who serve on the four days outside the count of the year (75:1), are mirrored on earth by Israel's courses of captains of thousands — the heavenly ranks ordering time as the priestly ranks order service.

members.old: Job 37:9 — *Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north.* Job sorts the winds by quarter just as Enoch's southern and northern portals send heat-and-drought against cold-and-drought.

members.new: Genesis 1:16 — *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also.* Enoch names the sun twice over — Orjârês and Tômâs (78:1) — the greater light of creation week, named out.

members.new: Psalm 148:5 — *Let them praise the name of Yahuah (LORD): for he commanded, and they were created.* Enoch names the sun by name — Orjârês and Tômâs (78:1); Psalm 148 grounds the naming in the Creator's command that made them.
