members.new: Psalm 1:1 — *Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.* Enoch's *blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners* (82:4) is the blessing of the man who does not walk in the way of sinners.

members.old: Psalm 1:2 — *But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law doth he meditate day and night.* The blessed keep the commandments of Yahuah of Spirits because their delight is in His law.
members.new: Psalm 1:2 — *But his delight is in the law of Yahuah (LORD); and in his law doth he meditate day and night.* The blessed walk in the way of righteousness and keep the reckoning of their days (82:4) because their delight is in his law.

members.old: Leviticus 23:4 — *These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.* To "complete their years in truth" is to keep the appointed feasts in their seasons, as the lights ordain them.
members.new: Leviticus 23:4 — *These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.* Blessed are those who sin not as the sinners in the reckoning of all their days (82:4) — to keep the count right is to keep the appointed feasts in their seasons, as the lights ordain them.

members.old: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* the luminaries do not alter their courses because their Maker fixed them for signs and seasons from creation.
members.new: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The luminaries do not alter their courses because their Maker fixed them for signs and seasons from creation — the exact account Uriel showed Enoch (82:7).

members.old: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The earth does not alter her seasons because the moon and sun keep their appointed courses.
members.new: Psalm 104:19 — *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* The seasons do not shift because the reckoning of the luminaries is exact and recorded (82:7); the moon and sun keep the courses they were appointed.

members.old: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts...* The law of the luminaries Enoch writes on the heavenly tablets is the same 364-day reckoning Jubilees commands Israel to keep.
members.new: Jubilees 6:32 — *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts...* The reckoning Enoch records as true for ever — the year completed in three hundred and sixty-four days (82:6) — is the same count Jubilees commands Israel to keep.

members.old: Leviticus 23:2 — *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* The chiefs of the four quarters and the feasts Enoch numbers are the appointed feasts of Yahuah, proclaimed by the lights.
members.new: Leviticus 23:2 — *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* The leaders who divide the four parts of the year and the months (82:11) mark the appointed feasts of Yahuah (LORD), proclaimed by the lights.

members.old: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* the leaders of the stars who do not transgress their commandments keep the very signs and seasons set at creation.
members.new: Genesis 1:14 — *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* The leaders who divide the parts of the year, the months and the days (82:11) keep the very signs and seasons set at creation.

members.old: Jubilees 6:17 — *For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year...* The feasts governed by Enoch's leaders of the seasons are the heavenly-tablet appointments by which the covenant is renewed.
members.new: Jubilees 6:17 — *For this reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tables, that they should celebrate the feast of weeks in this month once a year, to renew the covenant every year...* The feasts governed by Enoch's leaders of the four parts of the year and the twelve orders of the months (82:11) are the heavenly-tablet appointments by which the covenant is renewed.

members.old: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The violence that fills the earth is the corruption Enoch sees punished when the earth is swallowed in the abyss at 83:5.
members.new: Genesis 6:11 — *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* The violence that fills the earth is the corruption Enoch sees punished when the earth is swallowed in the abyss at 83:4.

members.old: Genesis 6:13 — *And Elohim (God) said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.* Enoch's "all that was upon the earth perished" (83:7) is this very decree against all flesh.
members.new: Genesis 6:13 — *And Elohim (God) said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.* The sin of the earth that sinks it into the abyss (83:7) is this very decree against all flesh.

members.old: Genesis 7:11 — *In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.* The broken-up deep is the great abyss that swallows the earth in Enoch's vision (83:5).
members.new: Genesis 7:11 — *In the six hundredth year of Noah's life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened.* The broken-up deep is the great abyss that swallows the earth in Enoch's vision (83:4).

members.old: Genesis 7:23 — *And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.* Enoch's "all that was upon the earth perished" (83:7) is the deluge that left only Noah's house alive.
members.new: Genesis 7:23 — *And every living substance was destroyed which was upon the face of the ground, both man, and cattle, and the creeping things, and the fowl of the heaven; and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noah only remained alive, and they that were with him in the ark.* The earth destroyed with a great destruction for the sin of the earth (83:7) is the deluge that left only Noah's house alive.

members.old: Isaiah 34:4 — *And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.* Enoch's heaven "rolled up like a scroll" with the luminaries falling (83:10) is Isaiah's Day-of-Yahuah unmaking of the host of heaven.
members.new: Isaiah 34:4 — *And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.* Isaiah's unmaking on the Day of Yahuah (the LORD) — the host falling as leaves from the vine — is the unmaking Enoch dreamed: the earth swallowed in the abyss and the mountains hurled down (83:4).

members.old: Revelation 6:14 — *And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.* The sixth seal repeats Enoch's scroll-rolled heaven (83:10) and the mountains displaced from his vision (83:5).
members.new: Revelation 6:14 — *And the heaven departed as a scroll when it is rolled together; and every mountain and island were moved out of their places.* The sixth seal's mountains and islands moved out of their places is Enoch's dream — mountains suspended on mountains, hills sinking on hills, as the earth is swallowed in the abyss (83:4).

members.old: Amos 7:5 — *Then said I, O Yahuah (Lord) GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.* The prophet's intercession for the small remnant echoes Enoch praying that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:9).
members.new: Amos 7:5 — *Then said I, O Yahuah (Lord) GOD, cease, I beseech thee: by whom shall Jacob arise? for he is small.* The prophet's intercession for the small remnant echoes Enoch praying that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:8).

members.old: Amos 7:6 — *Yahuah (LORD) repented for this: This also shall not be, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).* Yahuah relents at the prophet's plea, the very answer Enoch's intercession seeks when he prays the earth be spared (83:9).
members.new: Amos 7:6 — *Yahuah (LORD) repented for this: This also shall not be, saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD).* Yahuah relents at the prophet's plea, the very answer Enoch's intercession seeks when he prays the earth be spared (83:8).

members.old: Matthew 24:37 — *But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* Yahusha makes the Flood Enoch sees in his vision (83:6) the very type of the coming of the Son of Adam.
members.new: Matthew 24:37 — *But as the days of Noe were, so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* Yahusha (Jesus) makes the flood Mahalalel reads in Enoch's dream — the earth sinking into the abyss for the sin of the earth (83:7) — the type of the coming of the Son of Adam.

members.old: Matthew 24:39 — *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The Flood that takes all away is Enoch's "all that was upon the earth perished" (83:7), made the figure of the last day.
members.new: Matthew 24:39 — *And knew not until the flood came, and took them all away; so shall also the coming of the Son of Adam be.* The flood that takes all away is the great destruction Mahalalel names over Enoch's dream — the earth sinking into the abyss (83:7) — made the figure of the last day.

members.old: Genesis 8:1 — *And Elohim (God) remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and Elohim (God) made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged.* The remembering of Noah is the answer to Enoch's prayer that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:9) — a seed preserved through the waters.
members.new: Genesis 8:1 — *And Elohim (God) remembered Noah, and every living thing, and all the cattle that was with him in the ark: and Elohim (God) made a wind to pass over the earth, and the waters asswaged.* The remembering of Noah is the answer to Enoch's prayer that the whole earth not be destroyed (83:8) — a seed preserved through the waters.

members.old: 2 Peter 3:11 — *Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness.* Peter turns the dissolving earth of Enoch's vision (83:6) toward holy living, not toward law-as-curse.
members.new: 2 Peter 3:11 — *Seeing then that all these things shall be dissolved, what manner of persons ought ye to be in all holy conversation and godliness.* Peter turns the earth Enoch saw sink into the abyss and be destroyed with a great destruction (83:7) toward holy living, not toward law-as-curse.

members.old: Exodus 1:13 — *And the Egyptians made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to serve with rigour:* The twelve sheep given over to the wolves (89:15) is Israel made to serve Egypt with rigour.
members.new: Exodus 1:13 — *And the Egyptians made the children of Yashar'el (Israel) to serve with rigour:* The sheep given over to the wolves (89:13) is Israel made to serve Egypt with rigour.

members.old: Exodus 3:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;* The Lord of the sheep who hears the sheep's cry (89:16,19) is Yahuah hearing Israel's cry in Egypt.
members.new: Exodus 3:7 — *And Yahuah (LORD) said, I have surely seen the affliction of my people which are in Egypt, and have heard their cry by reason of their taskmasters; for I know their sorrows;* The Lord of the sheep who hears the sheep's cry (89:16) is Yahuah hearing Israel's cry in Egypt.

members.old: Exodus 3:8 — *And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey...* The Lord of the sheep coming down to deliver from the wolves (89:19) is Yahuah come down to deliver Israel.
members.new: Exodus 3:8 — *And I am come down to deliver them out of the hand of the Egyptians, and to bring them up out of that land unto a good land and a large, unto a land flowing with milk and honey...* The Lord of the sheep descending at the voice of the sheep from a lofty abode and pasturing them (89:16) is Yahuah (LORD) come down to deliver Israel.

members.old: Exodus 14:21 — *And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.* The wolves pursuing the fleeing sheep (89:18) is Pharaoh's pursuit broken at the divided sea.
members.new: Exodus 14:21 — *And Moses stretched out his hand over the sea; and Yahuah (LORD) caused the sea to go back by a strong east wind all that night, and made the sea dry land, and the waters were divided.* The wolves pursuing the sheep till they reached a sea of water (89:23) is Pharaoh's pursuit broken at the divided sea.

members.old: Exodus 14:28 — *And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.* The Lord of the sheep delivering it from the wolves (89:19) is the host of Pharaoh drowned in the returning sea.
members.new: Exodus 14:28 — *And the waters returned, and covered the chariots, and the horsemen, and all the host of Pharaoh that came into the sea after them; there remained not so much as one of them.* The sea gathering itself together and rising till it covered the wolves (89:26) is the host of Pharaoh drowned in the returning sea.

members.old: Exodus 14:30 — *Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.* The Lord of the sheep heard its cry and delivered it from the wolves (89:19) — Yahuah Himself saved Israel out of Egypt's hand.
members.new: Exodus 14:30 — *Thus Yahuah (LORD) saved Yashar'el (Israel) that day out of the hand of the Egyptians; and Yashar'el (Israel) saw the Egyptians dead upon the sea shore.* All the wolves who pursued the sheep perished and were drowned (89:27) — Yahuah (LORD) himself saved Israel out of Egypt's hand.

members.old: Exodus 19:4 — *Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.* The Lord bringing the saved sheep out from among the wolves to Himself (89:16,19) is Yahuah bearing Israel on eagles' wings to Himself.
members.new: Exodus 19:4 — *Ye have seen what I did unto the Egyptians, and how I bare you on eagles' wings, and brought you unto myself.* The Lord of the sheep coming down to the sheep that cried to him (89:16) is Yahuah (LORD) bearing Israel on eagles' wings to himself.

members.old: Exodus 19:18 — *And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.* The eyes of all the sheep opened to glorify the Lord of the sheep (89:23) is the flock at Sinai where Yahuah descended in fire.
members.new: Exodus 19:18 — *And mount Sinai was altogether on a smoke, because Yahuah (LORD) descended upon it in fire: and the smoke thereof ascended as the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mount quaked greatly.* The Lord of the sheep standing before them, great and terrible and majestic, so that all the sheep were afraid before his face (89:30), is Sinai, where Yahuah (LORD) descended in fire.

members.new: Exodus 19:6 — *And ye shall be unto me a kingdom of priests, and an holy nation. members.old: Exodus 24:8 — *And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.* The sheep speaking together and glorifying Yahuah (God) of Spirits (89:23) is the people sealed under the blood of the covenant.
members.new: Exodus 24:8 — *And Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, Behold the blood of the covenant, which Yahuah (LORD) hath made with you concerning all these words.* The sheep whose eyes began to open in the wilderness, pastured by the Lord of the sheep himself (89:28), are the people brought to the covenant he would seal with blood.

members.new: Psalm 80:1 — *Give ear, O Shepherd of Yashar'el (Israel), thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.* Enoch crying to the Lord of the sheep that they were devoured by all the wild beasts (89:57) is the cry to the Shepherd of Israel to shine forth on Joseph's scattered flock.

members.new: Daniel 7:10 — *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* The throne erected and the sealed books opened before the Lord of the sheep (90:20) is Daniel's judgment set and the books opened.

members.old: 1 Maccabees 2:1 — *In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.* The great horn that cries aloud to the sheep is read first against the Maccabean priest-line raised up to rally a scattered Israel.
members.new: 1 Maccabees 2:1 — *In those days arose Mattathias the son of John, the son of Simeon, a priest of the sons of Joarib, from Jerusalem, and dwelt in Modin.* The great horn that cried to the sheep so that the rams ran to it (90:10) is read first against the Maccabean priest-line raised up to rally a scattered Israel.

members.old: 1 Maccabees 2:66 — *As for Judas Maccabeus, he has been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.* The horn that grows great and butts the beasts down matches the mighty captain raised to fight the people's battle.
members.new: 1 Maccabees 2:66 — *As for Judas Maccabeus, he has been mighty and strong, even from his youth up: let him be your captain, and fight the battle of the people.* The great horn that sprouted on one of the sheep, whose eyes were opened (90:9), matches the mighty captain raised to fight the people's battle.

members.old: Jeremiah 23:5 — *Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.* The Lord of the sheep rejoicing over the horn points beyond the Maccabees to the righteous Branch raised to David.
members.new: Jeremiah 23:5 — *Behold, the days come, saith Yahuah (LORD), that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.* The Lord of the sheep rejoicing over the great one with the black horns and over all the oxen (90:38) points beyond the Maccabees to the righteous Branch raised to David.

members.old: Ezekiel 34:23 — *And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.* The Lord of the sheep empowering the horn is His setting up the one Davidic shepherd over the flock.
members.new: Ezekiel 34:23 — *And I will set up one shepherd over them, and he shall feed them, even my servant David; he shall feed them, and he shall be their shepherd.* The great horn raised on one of the sheep (90:9), with help sent to it from heaven (90:14), is the Lord's setting up of the one Davidic shepherd over the flock.

members.old: John 10:11 — *I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.* The Lord of the sheep rejoicing over horn and flock together is the good shepherd who lays down his life for his own.
members.new: John 10:11 — *I am the good shepherd: the good shepherd giveth his life for the sheep.* The Lord of the sheep rejoicing over the great one and over all the oxen (90:38) is the good shepherd who laid down his life for his own, now rejoicing over them.

members.old: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* The Lord of the sheep opening the books is the Ancient of days seated for judgment.
members.new: Daniel 7:9 — *I beheld till the thrones were cast down, and the Ancient of days did sit, whose garment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like the pure wool: his throne was like the fiery flame, and his wheels as burning fire.* The throne erected in the pleasant land, the Lord of the sheep seated on it, and the sealed books opened before him (90:20) is the Ancient of days seated for judgment.

members.old: Daniel 7:10 — *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* Enoch's opened books of the living and of the sinners are Daniel's set judgment with the books opened.
members.new: Daniel 7:10 — *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* The judgment held first over the stars, judged and found guilty and cast into the abyss of fire (90:24), is Daniel's set judgment with the books opened — the books of 90:20 opened and the sentence read.

members.old: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The books of the living opened in Enoch are the book of life at the white-throne judgment.
members.new: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The blinded sheep judged and found guilty and cast into the fiery abyss (90:26) is the white-throne judgment where the dead are judged by what is written in the books.

members.old: Jeremiah 23:1 — *Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith Yahuah (LORD).* The shepherds who had not fed the sheep, cast into the abyss, are the pastors woed for destroying and scattering the flock.
members.new: Jeremiah 23:1 — *Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith Yahuah (LORD).* The shepherds to whom the sheep were delivered for destruction, who trampled and devoured them (89:74), are the pastors woed for destroying and scattering the flock.

members.old: Jeremiah 23:2 — *Therefore thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith Yahuah (LORD).* The judged shepherds are visited for scattering and not visiting the flock.
members.new: Jeremiah 23:2 — *Therefore thus saith Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) of Yashar'el (Israel) against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith Yahuah (LORD).* The shepherds who trampled the sheep with their feet and devoured them (89:74) are visited for scattering and not visiting the flock.

members.old: Zechariah 11:17 — *Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.* The faithless shepherds cast into the fiery abyss answer the woe on the idol shepherd who leaves the flock.
members.new: Zechariah 11:17 — *Woe to the idol shepherd that leaveth the flock! the sword shall be upon his arm, and upon his right eye: his arm shall be clean dried up, and his right eye shall be utterly darkened.* The blinded shepherds who destroyed the sheep delivered to them (89:74) answer the woe on the idol shepherd who leaves the flock.

members.old: Revelation 20:10 — *And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.* The transgressing stars bound and cast into the fiery abyss are the deceiving powers consigned to the lake of fire.
members.new: Revelation 20:10 — *And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.* The stars judged and found guilty and cast into an abyss full of fire and pillars of fire (90:24) are the deceiving powers consigned to the lake of fire.

members.old: Revelation 21:2 — *And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.* The new house greater and loftier than the first is the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from heaven.
members.new: Revelation 21:2 — *And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from Elohim (God) out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.* The new house, large and broad and very full (90:36), is the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from heaven.

members.old: Ezekiel 37:21 — *And say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* The gathering of the recovered flock is the regathering of scattered Israel from the heathen into their land.
members.new: Ezekiel 37:21 — *And say unto them, Thus saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD); Behold, I will take the children of Yashar'el (Israel) from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:* All that had been destroyed and dispersed assembled in that house (90:33) is the regathering of scattered Israel from the heathen into their land.

members.old: Matthew 7:13 — *Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:* Yahusha's broad road to destruction is Enoch's 'paths of violence and death' that many hold to instead of righteousness (94:2).
members.new: Matthew 7:13 — *Enter ye in at the strait gate: for wide is the gate, and broad is the way, that leadeth to destruction, and many there be which go in thereat:* Yahusha's (Jesus's) broad road to destruction is Enoch's paths of violence and of death — revealed to a generation so that they hold themselves afar from them (94:2).

members.old: Psalm 49:6 — *They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;* the very posture Enoch condemns — trusting in riches instead of remembering the God of Spirits (94:3).
members.new: Psalm 49:6 — *They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;* the very posture Enoch condemns — trusting in riches instead of remembering the God of Spirits (94:8).

members.old: Psalm 49:7 — *None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:* riches cannot ransom a man in the day of affliction, exactly as Enoch says they 'shall not deliver you' (94:5).
members.new: Psalm 49:7 — *None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to Elohim (God) a ransom for him:* Riches cannot ransom a man — exactly what Enoch says the children of the earth will come to recognize: *their riches shall not be able to save them in the overthrow of their sins* (100:6).

members.old: Psalm 49:17 — *For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.* The rich man departs from his riches at death, just as Enoch warns 'from your riches shall you depart' (94:3).
members.new: Psalm 49:17 — *For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.* The rich man departs from his riches at death, just as Enoch warns 'from your riches shall you depart' (94:8).

members.old: Luke 12:20 — *But Elohim (God) said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?* Yahusha's rich fool who boasts 'we have become great and glorious' meets the same reckoning Enoch announces (94:4).
members.new: Luke 12:20 — *But Elohim (God) said unto him, Thou fool, this night thy soul shall be required of thee: then whose shall those things be, which thou hast provided?* Yahusha's (Jesus's) rich fool meets the same reckoning Enoch announces on those who say *we have become rich with riches and have possessions* (97:8).

members.old: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James pronounces Enoch's identical woe on the rich whose wealth will fail them (94:3).
members.new: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James pronounces Enoch's identical woe on the rich whose wealth will fail them (94:8).

members.old: Ecclesiasticus 11:19 — *Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.* Sirach mocks the hoarder's 'let us do what we purposed' plan with the very ignorance of his end that Enoch exposes (94:8).
members.new: Ecclesiasticus 11:19 — *Whereas he says, I have found rest, and now will eat continually of my goods; and yet he knoweth not what time shall come upon him, and that he must leave those things to others, and die.* Sirach mocks the hoarder's 'let us do what we purposed' plan with the very ignorance of his end that Enoch exposes (97:9).

members.old: Isaiah 5:8 — *Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!* Isaiah's woe on those who seize land and tread out the poor is Enoch's woe on those who 'tread upon the righteous with your might' (94:6).
members.new: Isaiah 5:8 — *Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!* Isaiah's woe on those who join house to house is Enoch's woe on those who build their houses with sin (94:7).

members.old: Isaiah 5:22 — *Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:* the mighty wine-drinkers Isaiah condemns are Enoch's who 'drink the finest wine, And tread upon the poor with your might' (94:18).
members.new: Isaiah 5:22 — *Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink:* the mighty wine-drinkers Isaiah condemns are Enoch's who 'drink the finest wine, And tread upon the poor with your might' (96:5).

members.old: James 5:5 — *Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.* James condemns the same self-indulgent feasting on the backs of others that Enoch pronounces woe upon (94:18).
members.new: James 5:5 — *Ye have lived in pleasure on the earth, and been wanton; ye have nourished your hearts, as in a day of slaughter.* James condemns the same self-indulgent feasting on the backs of others that Enoch pronounces woe upon (96:5).

members.old: Isaiah 5:20 — *Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!* — Isaiah's woe against inverting the moral order is Enoch's woe on those who alter the words of uprightness and write unrighteousness in 95:2.
members.new: Isaiah 5:20 — *Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!* Isaiah's woe against inverting the moral order is Enoch's woe on those who pervert the words of uprightness and transgress the eternal law (99:2).

members.old: Isaiah 5:21 — *Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!* — the self-wise who glory in their own lying are the godless of Enoch 95:1 who shall find no good.
members.new: Isaiah 5:21 — *Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!* — the self-wise who glory in their own lying are the godless of Enoch 99:1 who shall find no good.

members.old: Amos 6:7 — *Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.* — the banquet removed and the feasters led captive is the cutting-off of the rich oppressor's might in Enoch 95:4,7.
members.new: Amos 6:7 — *Therefore now shall they go captive with the first that go captive, and the banquet of them that stretched themselves shall be removed.* — the banquet removed and the feasters led captive is the cutting-off of the rich oppressor's might in Enoch 95:7.

members.old: Jeremiah 17:11 — *As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.* — riches acquired in unrighteousness (Enoch 95:7) end in folly and loss.
members.new: Jeremiah 17:11 — *As the partridge sitteth on eggs, and hatcheth them not; so he that getteth riches, and not by right, shall leave them in the midst of his days, and at his end shall be a fool.* — riches acquired in unrighteousness (Enoch 97:8) end in folly and loss.

members.old: Amos 5:11 — *Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.* The prophet's word for the very treading-and-feasting Enoch condemns in 96:1, and the houses the oppressors shall not keep.
members.new: Amos 5:11 — *Forasmuch therefore as your treading is upon the poor, and ye take from him burdens of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, but ye shall not drink wine of them.* The prophet's word for the very treading-and-feasting Enoch condemns in 96:5, and the houses the oppressors shall not keep.

members.old: Amos 5:12 — *For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.* The afflicting of the just stands behind Enoch's repeated charge that they tread upon the poor with their might (96:4).
members.new: Amos 5:12 — *For I know your manifold transgressions and your mighty sins: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside the poor in the gate from their right.* The afflicting of the just stands behind Enoch's repeated charge that they tread upon the poor with their might (96:5).

members.old: Isaiah 3:14 — *Yahuah (LORD) will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.* Those who devour the might of others and eat the best food (96:1) are the very princes who have eaten up the vineyard.
members.new: Isaiah 3:14 — *Yahuah (LORD) will enter into judgment with the ancients of his people, and the princes thereof: for ye have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses.* Those who devour the might of others and eat the best food (96:5) are the very princes who have eaten up the vineyard.

members.old: Isaiah 3:15 — *What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts.* Grinding the faces of the poor is Isaiah's image for the trampling Enoch denounces in 96:4.
members.new: Isaiah 3:15 — *What mean ye that ye beat my people to pieces, and grind the faces of the poor? saith Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) of hosts.* Grinding the faces of the poor is Isaiah's image for the trampling Enoch denounces in 96:5.

members.old: Proverbs 22:23 — *For Yahuah (LORD) will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.* Torah's guarantee that Yahuah avenges the oppressed poor is the ground of every woe Enoch pronounces in 96:1-4.
members.new: Proverbs 22:23 — *For Yahuah (LORD) will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.* Torah's guarantee that Yahuah avenges the oppressed poor is the ground of every woe Enoch pronounces in 96:4-8.

members.old: Luke 6:24 — *But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.* Yahusha's woe on the rich is the same sentence Enoch pronounces on the mighty in unrighteousness whose might shall be cut off (96:2).
members.new: Luke 6:24 — *But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) woe on the rich is the sentence Enoch pronounces on the mighty who oppress the righteous with their might: *the day of your destruction is coming* (96:8).

members.old: Luke 6:25 — *Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.* Nearly verbatim with Enoch 96:3 — the full shall be hungry and thirst.
members.new: Luke 6:25 — *Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) woe on the full is Enoch's woe on those who devour the finest of the wheat and drink wine in large bowls while treading the lowly under foot (96:5).

members.old: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens his woe on the rich exactly where Enoch does — the mighty in unrighteousness facing the cutting-off of their might (96:2).
members.new: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens his woe on the rich where Enoch does — the mighty who oppress the righteous, whose day of destruction is coming (96:8).

members.old: James 5:3 — *Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.* The cankering of hoarded wealth is how James shows the might cut off that Enoch warns of in 96:2.
members.new: James 5:3 — *Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.* The cankering of hoarded wealth is how James shows the day of destruction Enoch warns the mighty of (96:8).

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* Wisdom voices the doomed rich confessing the emptiness of the fatness Enoch says shall turn to hunger (96:3).
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 5:8 — *What has pride profited us? or what good has riches with our vaunting brought us?* Wisdom voices the doomed rich confessing the emptiness of their feasting — the finest of the wheat and the wine in large bowls Enoch's woe names (96:5).

members.old: Luke 12:18 — *And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.* The rich fool's brimming barns are the very granaries Enoch's hoarders boast of in 96:7.
members.new: Luke 12:18 — *And he said, This will I do: I will pull down my barns, and build greater; and there will I bestow all my fruits and my goods.* The rich fool's brimming barns are the very granaries Enoch's hoarders boast of in 97:9.

members.old: Luke 12:19 — *And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.* The fool's self-talk matches the boast Enoch puts in the rich man's mouth — we have acquired everything we desired (96:5).
members.new: Luke 12:19 — *And I will say to my soul, Soul, thou hast much goods laid up for many years; take thine ease, eat, drink, and be merry.* The fool's self-talk matches the boast Enoch puts in the rich man's mouth — we have acquired everything we desired (97:8).

members.old: Amos 8:5 — *Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?* Amos shows the rigged scales by which the gold of 96:5 was acquired in unrighteousness.
members.new: Amos 8:5 — *Saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat, making the ephah small, and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances by deceit?* Amos shows the rigged scales by which the gold of 97:8 was acquired in unrighteousness.

members.old: Amos 8:6 — *That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?* The wheat hoarded in Enoch's full granaries (96:7) is the same refuse Amos says was sold by defrauding the needy.
members.new: Amos 8:6 — *That we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; yea, and sell the refuse of the wheat?* The wheat hoarded in Enoch's full granaries (97:9) is the same refuse Amos says was sold by defrauding the needy.

members.old: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The many labourers of Enoch 96:8 are James' reapers whose withheld wages cry to Yahuah of hosts.
members.new: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The mighty who oppress the righteous with their might (96:8) are James's rich men whose withheld wages cry to Yahuah (Lord) of hosts.

members.old: Ecclesiasticus 34:22 — *He that takes away his neighbour's living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.* Ben Sira makes defrauding the many labourers of Enoch 96:8 a deed of blood, the very crime drawing the woe.
members.new: Ecclesiasticus 34:22 — *He that takes away his neighbour's living slayeth him; and he that defraudeth the labourer of his hire is a bloodshedder.* Ben Sira makes defrauding the labourer a deed of blood — the oppression of the righteous by might that Enoch's woe names (96:8).

members.old: James 5:3 — *Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.* The hoarded silver and gold of Enoch 97:7-8 becomes the very witness that eats the flesh of those who gathered it in unrighteousness.
members.new: James 5:3 — *Your gold and silver is cankered; and the rust of them shall be a witness against you, and shall eat your flesh as it were fire. Ye have heaped treasure together for the last days.* The hoarded silver and gold of Enoch 97:8-8 becomes the very witness that eats the flesh of those who gathered it in unrighteousness.

members.old: Habakkuk 2:6 — *Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!* Habakkuk's taunting woe against the man who increases what is not his is the same charge Enoch 97:8 lays on those who say 'let us do what we purposed.'
members.new: Habakkuk 2:6 — *Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his! how long? and to him that ladeth himself with thick clay!* Habakkuk's taunting woe against the man who increases what is not his is the same charge Enoch 97:9 lays on those who say 'let us do what we purposed.'

members.old: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The poor trodden in Enoch 97:6 are James's defrauded reapers, whose cry has already entered the ears of Yahuah.
members.new: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The poor trodden in Enoch 96:5 are James's defrauded reapers, whose cry has already entered the ears of Yahuah.

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* Almost verbatim with Enoch 102:3 — the righteous dead rest in Elohim's hand, untouched by torment, while only the sinners are held in Sheol.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* Wisdom's souls of the righteous in the hand of Elohim (God) are the souls Enoch tells not to fear, that have died in righteousness (102:4) — grieve not that the body went into Sheol; wait for the day.

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 3:2 — *In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,* matching the very taunt Enoch's sinners raise at 102:5-6 — the world reads the righteous death as defeat and cannot see the path that runs through it.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 3:2 — *In the sight of the unwise they seemed to die: and their departure is taken for misery,* Wisdom's unwise who take the righteous death for misery are Enoch's sinners speaking over the righteous dead — *as we die, so die the righteous, and what benefit do they reap for their deeds?* (102:6). The world reads that death as defeat and cannot see the path that runs through it.

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The no-torment promise of Enoch 102:3 is the hope of immortality — the righteous suffer in the world's eyes but are kept whole in Elohim's hand.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope full of immortality is Enoch's word to the righteous dead: fear not, and be hopeful, ye that have died in righteousness (102:4) — punished in the world's eyes, kept whole before him.

members.old: Daniel 12:1 — *...and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Enoch's separation of righteous from sinners (102:1-2) is Daniel's deliverance — the deciding line is the name already written, election before any confession.
members.new: Daniel 12:1 — *...and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* When he brings a grievous fire and there is nowhere to flee (102:1), Daniel's deliverance belongs to every one found written in the book — the deciding line is the name already written, election before any confession.

members.old: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* Enoch's righteous *shining like the sun* (102:7) is Daniel's resurrection-radiance of the wise.
members.new: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* Enoch's righteous who shall shine as the lights of heaven (104:2) are Daniel's resurrection-radiance of the wise.

members.old: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The separation of the righteous dead from the sinners in Enoch 102:2 is the two-fold awakening — life for the one, shame for the other.
members.new: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The division made in Sheol between the spirits of the righteous and the rest (22:9) is Daniel's two-fold awakening — life for the one, shame for the other.

members.old: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha's own words for the harvest's end exactly render Enoch 102:7 — the righteous shining like the sun.
members.new: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) own words for the harvest's end render Enoch's close: those born in darkness led into darkness, while the righteous shall be resplendent (108:14).

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 5:3 — *And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:* the mockers of Enoch 102:6 (“these are they who have despised us”) seen now from the other side — the despisers confessing too late.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 5:3 — *And they repenting and groaning for anguish of spirit shall say within themselves, This was he, whom we had sometimes in derision, and a proverb of reproach:* The mockers who spoke over the righteous dead — *as we die, so die the righteous* (102:6) — seen now from the other side: the despisers confessing too late.

members.old: Wisdom of Solomon 5:5 — *How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!* The sinners' astonishment at the shining righteous in Enoch 102:7 is this very cry — the despised are found among the elect.
members.new: Wisdom of Solomon 5:5 — *How is he numbered among the children of Yahuah (God), and his lot is among the saints!* The righteous shining as the lights of heaven, seen at last with the portals of heaven opened to them (104:2), is this very cry — the despised found among the elect.

members.old: Amos 6:6 — *That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.* Enoch's drinkers of wine in large bowls (102:12) are Amos's feasters indifferent to the suffering of the people.
members.new: Amos 6:6 — *That drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments: but they are not grieved for the affliction of Joseph.* Enoch's drinkers of wine in large bowls (96:5) are Amos's feasters indifferent to the suffering of the people.

members.old: Malachi 4:2 — *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.* The righteous shining like the sun in Enoch 102:7 meet the Sun of righteousness who rises for those who fear Yahuah's name — the other end from the furnace.
members.new: Malachi 4:2 — *But unto you that fear my name shall the Sun of righteousness arise with healing in his wings; and ye shall go forth, and grow up as calves of the stall.* The righteous in the light of the sun, the elect in the light of eternal life (58:3), meet the Sun of righteousness who rises for those who fear Yahuah's (the LORD's) name — the other end from the furnace.

members.old: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening Daniel sees is the very life Enoch swears the righteous spirits shall not lose.
members.new: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening Daniel sees is the very life Enoch swears the righteous spirits shall not lose (103:4).

members.old: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The light Yahuah causes to appear on Enoch's righteous (103:4) is Daniel's firmament-shining.
members.new: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The spirits of the righteous dead that shall live and rejoice before the face of the Great One (103:4) are Daniel's wise, shining as the firmament.

members.old: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha confirms the same shining of the righteous Enoch promises under oath.
members.new: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha (Jesus) confirms what Enoch promises under oath: the spirits of those who died in righteousness shall live and rejoice and their memorial shall not perish (103:4) — the righteous shining in the Father's kingdom.

members.old: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* The same safekeeping of the righteous spirits that Enoch swears shall not perish.
members.new: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:1 — *But the souls of the righteous are in the hand of Yahuah (God), and there shall no torment touch them.* The same safekeeping of the righteous spirits: they shall live and rejoice, and their memorial shall not perish from before the face of the Great One (103:4).

members.old: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope full of immortality is the satisfied life Enoch swears the righteous shall have (103:7).
members.new: The Wisdom of Solomon 3:4 — *For though they be punished in the sight of men, yet is their hope full of immortality.* The hope full of immortality is the life Enoch swears the righteous dead shall have — their spirits shall live and rejoice and not perish (103:4).

members.old: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where Enoch sees the righteous already written (103:3).
members.new: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where Enoch sees goodness and glory written down for the spirits of those who died in righteousness (103:3).

members.old: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The same opening of the books of the living and of the unrighteous that Enoch witnesses (103:9).
members.new: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* The sinners say their sins will not be searched out and written down; Enoch answers that they are written down every day (104:7). John's opened books are those records.

members.old: Revelation 14:13 — *And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in Yahuah (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.* The blessing on the righteous dead, whose names stand in the books of life (103:3).
members.new: Revelation 14:13 — *And I heard a voice from heaven saying unto me, Write, Blessed are the dead which die in Yahusha (Lord) from henceforth: Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; and their works do follow them.* The blessing on the righteous dead — all goodness and joy and glory prepared and written down for the spirits of those who have died in righteousness (103:3).

members.old: Luke 16:23 — *And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.* The torment-side of Sheol where Enoch sees the sinners' spirits cast into darkness (103:10).
members.new: Luke 16:23 — *And in hell he lift up his eyes, being in torments, and seeth Abraham afar off, and Lazarus in his bosom.* The torment-side of Sheol is the darkness and chains and burning flame where Enoch says the sinners' spirits enter, where there is grievous judgment (103:8).

members.old: Luke 16:24 — *And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.* The cry from Sheol that Enoch says shall not be heard nor ascend to heaven (103:10-11).
members.new: Luke 16:24 — *And he cried and said, Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water, and cool my tongue; for I am tormented in this flame.* The cry from the flame is the cry Enoch hears from the darkness and chains and burning flame where the sinners' spirits enter (103:8).

members.old: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The end of the names found in the books of the unrighteous that Enoch witnesses opened (103:9).
members.new: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The end of those whose names are blotted out of the book of life (108:3): their seed destroyed, their spirits slain, and the fire — the same end for the unwritten.

members.old: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens the very woe Enoch pronounces on the rich whose glory shall not last (103:15, 24).
members.new: James 5:1 — *Go to now, ye rich men, weep and howl for your miseries that shall come upon you.* James opens the very woe Enoch pronounces on those who acquire silver and gold in unrighteousness and say they have everything they desired (97:8).

members.old: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The defrauded labourers' cry answers Enoch's woe on those who tread upon the righteous with their might (103:14).
members.new: James 5:4 — *Behold, the hire of the labourers who have reaped down your fields, which is of you kept back by fraud, crieth: and the cries of them which have reaped are entered into the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.* The cry the rulers would not hear — *cried out against those who devoured us, But they did not attend to our cries* (103:14) — is the cry James says has entered the ears of Yahuah (Lord) of sabaoth.

members.old: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening of the dust-sleepers is the very resurrection Enoch promises the righteous in 104:2-5.
members.new: Daniel 12:2 — *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt.* The awakening of the dust-sleepers is the very resurrection Enoch promises the righteous in 104:2–5 — hope not cast away, joy as the angels (104:4).

members.old: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* Yahuah causing His light to appear on the righteous (104:4) is Daniel's wise shining as the firmament.
members.new: Daniel 12:3 — *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* The great joy as the angels of heaven Enoch promises the righteous (104:4) is Daniel's wise shining as the firmament.

members.old: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha seals Enoch's promise: the righteous shine in the Father's kingdom.
members.new: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha (Jesus) seals Enoch's promise: the righteous shine in the Father's kingdom — great joy as the angels of heaven (104:4).

members.old: the Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* The same extra-canonical resurrection-shining: the righteous vindicated and luminous at their visitation.
members.new: the Wisdom of Solomon 3:7 — *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble.* Wisdom's righteous shining at their visitation are Enoch's righteous who will not have to hide on the day of the great judgment and will not be found as sinners (104:5).

members.old: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where the righteous names of 104:3 are written before the Most High.
members.new: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The book of remembrance is the same heavenly register where the names of the righteous are written before the glory of the Great One (104:1).

members.old: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Deliverance belongs to every one written in the book — Enoch's elect whose names stand before the Most High.
members.new: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* Deliverance belongs to every one written in the book — Enoch's righteous whose names are written before the glory of the Great One (104:1).

members.old: Psalm 69:28 — *Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.* Enoch's righteous name shall NOT be blotted out (104:8); the wicked are blotted, never the elect written-in.
members.new: Psalm 69:28 — *Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.* Enoch's righteous memorial shall NOT perish before the Great One (103:4); the wicked are blotted, never the elect written-in.

members.old: Revelation 3:5 — *He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.* Yahusha's promise not to blot the overcomer's name is Enoch's name that shall not be blotted out.
members.new: Revelation 3:5 — *He that overcometh, the same shall be clothed in white raiment; and I will not blot out his name out of the book of life, but I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.* Yahusha's (Jesus's) promise not to blot the overcomer's name is Enoch's memorial that shall not perish from before the face of the Great One (103:4).

members.old: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* John's opened books are Enoch's books of the living and of the unrighteous opened in 104:9.
members.new: Revelation 20:12 — *And I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened: and another book was opened, which is the book of life: and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works.* John's opened books are the records Enoch names: all your oppression written down every day till the day of your judgment (98:8).

members.old: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The fire that receives the unwritten is the darkness and destruction into which Enoch's sinners are cast (104:10-12).
members.new: Revelation 20:15 — *And whosoever was not found written in the book of life was cast into the lake of fire.* The fire that receives the unwritten is the darkness and chains and burning flame Enoch's sinners enter, where there is grievous judgment (103:8).

members.old: Isaiah 5:8 — *Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!* Isaiah's woe on the land-engrossers matches Enoch's woe on those who acquire gold and silver in unrighteousness (104:15).
members.new: Isaiah 5:8 — *Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no place, that they may be placed alone in the midst of the earth!* Isaiah's woe on the land-engrossers matches Enoch's woe on those who acquire gold and silver in unrighteousness (97:8).

members.old: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The Most High knowing the names of the righteous (Enoch 105:2) is the book of remembrance kept for those who fear Him.
members.new: Malachi 3:16 — *Then they that feared Yahuah (LORD) spake often one to another: and Yahuah (LORD) hearkened, and heard it, and a book of remembrance was written before him for them that feared Yahuah (LORD), and that thought upon his name.* The righteous whose memorial does not perish before the face of the Great One (103:4) are the ones in the book of remembrance kept for those who fear him.

members.old: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* The memorial before Him (Enoch 105:2) is deliverance for every name already written in the book — election before the trouble, not after.
members.new: Daniel 12:1 — *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.* The memorial before the face of the Great One (103:4) is deliverance for every name already written in the book — election before the trouble, not after.

members.old: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* The sinner's end as the lake of fire (Enoch 105:1) is the canon's furnace into which the tares of the seed-war are gathered.
members.new: Matthew 13:42 — *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.* The sinner's end — darkness and chains and a burning flame where there is grievous judgment (103:8) — is the canon's furnace into which the tares of the seed-war are gathered.

members.old: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha gives the same shining-righteous resurrection that closes Enoch's book.
members.new: Matthew 13:43 — *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* Yahusha (Jesus) gives the righteous shining in their Father's kingdom; Enoch gives the children of the earth seeing the wise in security at last (100:6).
